Berdasarkan laporan, “she could have just not used any of it,” he says. “and I just would not have been as funny in it. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa on the episode of the variety awards circuit podcast, rogen discusses his one-two punch of “the invite” and “tangles,” along with the recently announced “darkwing duck” revival at disney+, the awards-season satire threaded through season 2 of “the studio” and how “steve jobs” opened a door to a part of the industry he had never been invited into. Listen below!.

Among comedians, he says, going dramatic “almost feels like a bit of a cheat code” and he recalls Jonah Hill predicting “Moneyball” (2011) would bring him the most acclaim of his career for doing the least (Hill was right, getting his first Oscar nom for supporting actor).

Berdasarkan laporan, “tangles,” on the other hand, is a different kind of gamble. The hand-drawn, black-and-white animated feature, adapted from Sarah Leavitt’s graphic memoir about her mother’s Alzheimer’s and directed by first-time feature filmmaker Leah Nelson, comes from Rogen’s Point Grey Pictures and features his voice alongside Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Abbi Jacobson, Bryan Cranston and Samira Wiley. In a category ruled by studio franchises, it is the outlier and it took 10 years to make and the Canadian multihyphenate always had his eye on what’s most important. “When we give up on it is when it doesn’t happen,” he says.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, independent film company and sapan studio open “tangles” in theaters this year for an awards-qualifying run, with a wider expansion in early 2027. “The Invite” is streaming on HBO Max.

The conversation has been edited and condensed for clarity.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you’re having quite a year, with two very different movies in “the invite” and “tangles. ” You’re coming off “The Studio,” and there’s been a lot of anticipation about what you’ll do next. This is quite a one-two punch. How does this moment in your career feel?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i feel very lucky. It’s incredibly nice and gratifying that, over the last few years, I feel like I’ve been doing work I’m very proud of and pushing myself to do things that are hopefully different from what I’ve done in the past. You only want to hope that you’re learning more in life, that you’re getting better at making choices and that once you’ve decided to do something, you get better at being the best part of the team you can be. And part of it is coincidence. We didn’t know it was going to come out now. But I also feel very lucky to have people who have wanted to work with me and have been willing to. We’ve worked on “Tangles” for 10 years. Luck has a lot to do with these things coming to life in a way that makes it seem like I planned it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, starting with “the invite,” this might be your finest hour as an actor. On paper, it sounds like a movie Seth Rogen would make. Playing Joe, did you feel you were doing something you hadn’t done before? Did you have one of those out-of-body experiences?.

Diungkapkan bahwa as we were making the movie, i felt like i was being given the opportunity, at least in a movie, to do something that was very representative of my exact comedic, tonal and dramatic taste. She allowed Edward to give dramatic monologues in places where they weren’t originally going to be. What was really amazing about what Olivia did was that she allowed us to affect the tone of the film with our performances. She allowed me to insert humor in moments where it wasn’t originally going to be, which changes the tone of the whole thing. And then she allowed me to make jokes that subverted those moments in ways that weren’t originally scripted.

Berdasarkan laporan, to me, that was an incredibly new and gratifying feeling. You could see it happening in real time. We weren’t just being invited to change the dialogue or our characters throughout the performing process. You could see that a scene was much funnier than we thought it would be. Or we thought a scene was going to be funny, but it was actually much more intense than we all thought. Olivia was allowing us to change the tone of the film itself with our performances. We were encouraged to play with that and not be too beholden to what it was originally conceived as, but instead feel it out as we were doing it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i have to give her credit for using my stuff in a way that turned out very well. I throw a lot of stuff out there, and she could have edited this movie in a way that left out some of what I think are the funniest moments I generated as we were making it. The film probably still would have been very good, but I just wouldn’t have been as funny in it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so i’m very proud that it’s a performance people seem to like, and i genuinely feel it’s one of my funnier performances. And it’s for sure the easiest thing I’ve done, because I’m just doing less than I normally do. So what’s nice is that I do feel like I was creating comedy throughout this film, and people are appreciating that. I remember Jonah Hill was making “Moneyball,” and he said, “This is going to be the thing that I get the most acclaim for. ” And I’ve done things like that. If I’m not funny, everyone leans in a little bit more. I’ve done dramatic work in the past, and I think among comedians it almost feels like a bit of a cheat code. It isn’t just because it’s not funny that people are appreciating it, which is something I think a lot of comedians have experienced.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s the jim carrey cheat code. He gets to do “The Truman Show” and “Eternal Sunshine,” and suddenly we’re all saying, “My God. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, yes. It’s obviously an honor to get to be in Steven Spielberg movies and things like that are certainly less comedic, and the fact that those filmmakers think I can serve their work in any way is very flattering. That’s exactly what Olivia really encouraged me to do. I’ve always been most proud of my funny work. There was a time when comedians really pursued that and wanted that, and I think it was a very deliberate thing comedians were doing for a while. I totally get it. It’s totally legitimate. It’s just that, to me, I’m very proud of my ability to generate comedy on camera. But I’m always thinking, if I could also bring my full ability to make this comedic, that would be great. So it was very gratifying to be able to bring that.

Berdasarkan laporan, i love that comedic actors can make that transition so seamlessly. I want to see the Christopher Nolan version of “Superbad. I’m also dying for directors who are known for drama to go the other way. ” I want them to take a swing like that.

Sebagaimana diketahui, apparently, “digger” is that. Comedians try to do drama, and sometimes it’s ill-fitting. I haven’t seen it. It’s harder than it looks sometimes. I’m not saying that film is that. Dramatic actors try to do comedy, and sometimes that’s ill-fitting, too. I haven’t seen it yet. It does go both ways. But it’s something I’ve seen happen.

Berdasarkan laporan, then there’s “tangles,” which is about as far from “the invite” as you can get. The animated feature category at the Oscars has been dominated by studio franchises for years, and now we have this hand-drawn, black-and-white film about Alzheimer’s. I think people need to hear the answer to this: How difficult is it to make a movie like this?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, really hard [laughs]. We’ve been working on it for 10 years, and I think maybe the last three years of that were production. So it was about seven years of us internally developing it, but also trying to find financing, putting together a cast that would be appealing to financiers, doing readings and making sure the script was really, really good.

Berdasarkan laporan, and the movie itself was made incredibly differently. You screen them, redo the third act, screen them again and redo the first act. Most animated movies, these big studio ones, are made, then made again, then made again. It had to be written and then executed, and we could change almost nothing. This movie couldn’t be made that way. It’s hand-drawn, so the process of changing things, should you want to, is incredibly labor-intensive and arduous.

Berdasarkan laporan, people like julia louis-dreyfus, bryan cranston, samira wiley and abbi jacobson, along with so many of the amazing cast members, were honestly really helpful in getting the movie made. So was having a good script and filmmakers who, when those actors got in the room with them, were willing to let them take ownership of the material. It’s so gratifying that the movie even exists. We’ve spent so long working on it.

During those first seven years, how many times did you think, “This isn’t happening?”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i thought it would happen. “Superbad” took so long to get made. Sometimes we don’t give up, and we will bring it into existence through sheer brute force. If something is good, I believe you can find a way to make it. This felt worth it because it was good. And then there were things like “Pineapple Express” and “Sausage Party,” all these movies we worked on for so long before they were made. So many things take a long time to get made. I truly believe that if we give up on it, that’s when it doesn’t happen. To me, 10 years is normal.

Berdasarkan laporan, “darkwing duck” because i’m a child of the ’80s and ’90s. Congratulations on the Emmy for “The Muppet Show,” and obviously we have “The Studio” Season 2 coming. But nothing excites me more than this cartoon classic that Mark Hamill has a role in! Did that casting fall into your lap?.

Berdasarkan laporan, the cast is really great. I’ve been watching the episodes, and they’re amazing. But it’s incredible. We’ve been working on it for a very long time. I’ll tell you after. You get caught up in these corporate restructurings, but we’ve been working on “Darkwing Duck” for years and years. We just cast a Scrooge McDuck who might be the most exciting casting I could ever imagine. They’re coming together so well, and the animation is beautiful and really inventive.

I was actually surprised you didn’t go the movie route.

Berdasarkan laporan, i’m glad we didn’t. The TV nature of it was very appealing to us, honestly. Getting to work in both those ways is nice. As nice as it is to make a hand-drawn, black-and-white animated film, it’s also nice to extract every penny Disney’s willing to put into a thing. But with something like “Darkwing Duck,” we felt that if we were going to do it, it had to be top, top-notch.

Sebagaimana diketahui, are there other disney shows from the ’80s and ’90s you’d love to bring back? i think of “talespin,” “gummi bears” and “ducktales. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i always think of “flight of the navigator. Years ago, when we were first talking about doing “Darkwing Duck” again, I rewatched all of it and thought, this is really meta. “Darkwing Duck,” though, I loved. I would never presume I’d do it, but that’s always been a movie I thought was cool. And it’s very meta. ” That was a Disney movie, I guess. It’s funny, I reread those “Calvin and Hobbes” comics recently and I realized they really formed a lot of my personality. It really breaks the fourth wall and comments on these shows I was also watching at the same time, at the same age.

If we can get “Gargoyles” back up and running ….

Sebagaimana diketahui, that would be great. I did love “Gargoyles. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, let’s talk about “the studio” season 2. There have been a lot of reports from the set: Madonna, the Venice Film Festival. Which real-life awards-season humiliation of yours is going to end up on the show?.

How much does Variety figure into the new season?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i think it comes up. I don’t want to reveal too much, but some of the stuff has made it out publicly into the world a little bit. This idea of playing the awards game as a studio is definitely a theme explored throughout the season.

Do you have a Season 2 equivalent of the Martin Scorsese moment, when viewers see who’s appearing and think, “I can’t believe they got him?” Does Christopher Nolan show up, for example?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we have several of those. We wanted to get people we were even bigger fans of and make them even bigger parts of the episodes, if we could. Some are really unbelievable, and having to direct these people has been among the most terrifying moments of my entire life. For ourselves, we really tried to be even more ambitious. We also wanted to dig deeper into our own feelings about the industry and our own internal conflicts as we go about all this.

Does the awards race feel more or less relevant to you now? Having made “The Studio,” how does it look compared with 15 years ago?.

Diungkapkan bahwa what’s interesting is that until i did the “steve jobs” movie, which was pretty deep into my career, i was never part of anything that was on that journey in any capacity. But that was the first time I went to Telluride, and then we were in the New York Film Festival. I’d been to TIFF and South by Southwest to premiere things. Honestly, it was like a door to a secret part of the industry that I’d never been invited into was suddenly opened. So it’s interesting, because I had a very lovely career before any of this was even on my radar.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but that being said, the fact that “the studio” won awards got us things in the second season that we probably wouldn’t have gotten in the first season. So there is some tangible outcome to some of this stuff. And I’ve seen people go on the journey and not get the outcome they wanted, and they had a good time and seemed to have good perspective at the end of all of it. I’ve seen people go on this journey and get the exact outcome they were hoping for, and it ultimately gave them none of the things they hoped it would. I understand why people get invested in it, and I understand the lure and the draw. It is a fascinating part of our industry to me.

Berdasarkan laporan, i think especially for smaller things, it is incredibly helpful. But what’s interesting is those people are at these events right next to the people whose lives it will change. If you’ve already made many billion-dollar movies, winning best picture is a feather in your cap. It could make or break people’s careers. It could make or break a film. It could change the course of people’s lives. For some people, they’re at the point of their career where awards have very personal stakes, but there are many other people here for whom the awards have real-life stakes. It’s not going to change the course of your life, per se. To me, that is really interesting to see in real life and really cool. Will they get to do the thing they’ve always wanted to do, or will it not happen the way they hoped?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that is really interesting and scary and cool to see play out. There are those moments where your heart is pounding and you’re like, we’re doing it. This is what we asked for: to put ourselves out there and subject ourselves to reality in terms of how our work is being perceived. It can be very gratifying and incredibly scary and stressful.

Can you tell me something about “The Studio” Season 2? Is there a oner episode again?.

Diungkapkan bahwa we actually try to do much more of that. There are more episodes in a much more condensed timeline. I think there are technically several episodes this season that have no cuts in them, basically, throughout the entire thing. They’re real-time, half-hour moments in time that the episode is chronicling.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s a weird time in the industry. Depending on who you ask, the future looks very grim. Others say it’s an evolution and we’re just going through some changes. One of the biggest conversations here at Middleburg was Peter Rice going to Netflix. Someone like him, who’s been such a theatrical guy, making that move feels like a signal: Theatrical’s back! How do you feel about this moment? Do you get nervous, or do you think we’re going to be OK?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s a mixture of everything. The fact that so many people are going to theaters, compared to the last few years, is so encouraging. It reminds me of when I was a kid, honestly, a little bit more. As someone who loves going to the movies, it’s really fun to see. I think we are finally getting over that hump of the pandemic and the strikes and all that. It is everything at once. It seems like things are returning to a time when there are a lot of good movies and people are willing to go see them, and that’s really exciting. From my own personal lens, I can go to the theater on a Tuesday night and it’s packed and it wasn’t like that for a long time. I’m very optimistic about some things. And I think other things are terrifying.

Berdasarkan laporan, “sethical. ” Friends from growing up still call me that when I see them. They don’t even think about it. It just comes out.

Something you loved as a kid but can’t believe you were into when you think about it now?.

Diungkapkan bahwa i get why people like “magic: the gathering,” but i spent every penny i had on “magic: the gathering” cards. That’s the thing I look back on, and I’m like, I should have bought other stuff.

Berdasarkan laporan, i don’t karaoke as a rule. Now you’re in a little room with just your friends in it, screaming your ass off like an idiot. If karaoke went away altogether, I’d never need to be in a room with some drunk person screaming a song ever again. That said, “All for Love” by Bryan Adams. I hate it. The rooms are getting smaller and smaller. It used to be the bar was higher because you were subjecting yourself to a real big room full of people. Now I’m three feet away from this person. It’s so loud. If you have two other raspy-voiced friends, it’s a really good song.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i was going to say “the apartment. ” I would take “The Apartment. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i’m pretty flexible. I can almost get my leg behind my head.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i just like vanilla. I did that movie with Barbra Streisand [”The Guilt Trip”], and she was obsessed with McConnell’s ice cream, which is from Santa Barbara. Every scene we shot, she’s like, “Wouldn’t we be eating ice cream in this scene?” So yes, it’s become McConnell’s.

Sebagaimana diketahui, my glasses come to mind. My shoes. Things like that.

What TV show or film in all of history do you wish you were a cast member of?.

Maybe it would have been cool to be in “Ghostbusters” or something like that.

Which fictional character do you most relate to or admire?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i always liked homer simpson. Not that I relate to or admire him, but I always just liked him.

Your favorite piece of advice, either given or received?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i was told at a very young age to write what only i could write, which meant writing things based on my own experience, things that were happening to me. Don’t talk about fucking crazy glue. Talk about that. I was writing jokes that were observational, like, “What’s the deal with crazy glue?” Those kinds of jokes. No one else can talk about that. I was maybe 15, maybe 14 and he pulled me aside and said, “Dude, you’re out there trying to get hand jobs and trying to buy beer and trying to sneak into parties and shit. I was doing OK. ” It was honestly the best creative advice I’ve ever gotten. Any asshole can write that joke. A stand-up comedian named Darryl Lenox, who’s passed away, unfortunately, told me that and he was really nice to me. I try to adhere to it to this day.

The Alejandro Monteverde-directed action epic earned a whopping 99% audience score on the site, highlighting just how much viewers connected with the film. As a result, many have high expectations for Ghost Soldier.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s no surprise, then, that jim caviezel is back in another action film that embraces many of the same themes and values as sound of freedom. In the new film, Caviezel plays a former special operatives soldier who is forced to protect his town from a villainous corporation seeking to displace residents from their homes in order to build a cooling plant for AI data centers.

Diungkapkan bahwa ghost soldier is described as a faith-based action film, and one that is being released on veterans day because of the military themes present throughout. Caviezel’s Henry Fitzgerald isn’t the only character to have served in the military, and the film shows how the action follows Fitz even after he departed the service. All of this builds up to a jam-packed finale, and one that puts Fitz in grave danger as he pushes back against the company and its third party mercenaries.

Sebagaimana diketahui, at the heart of this story is a villainous company called the brownstone corporation. The fictional company is deeply involved in artificial intelligence and is led by foreign investors based in the Middle East. Blackstone is said to have invested significant amounts of money in new artificial intelligence data centers and are intent on ensuring their long-term success.

Berdasarkan laporan, fitz defeats brownstone with a meticulous plan, and one that begins long before the grand finale. For starters, he goes to the home of the Brownstone lawyer that accompanied their mercenaries to the Hernandez residence and uses threats of torture to coerce useful information out of her. What's more, he lays the groundwork for the company's downfall by convincing her to take what she knows to the press.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, a lot more is needed in order to take down brownstone. Fitz recognizes this, and opts to use his many advanced weapons in battle against the company’s mercenaries. One of these weapons is a cloak of invisibility, something that feels as if it’s been pulled straight from the wizarding world of Harry Potter.

Berdasarkan laporan, fitz uses this cloak, along with his many other weapons, as he infiltrates a brownstone party, held to celebrate their recent successes and the launch of their plans. Fitz poses as a waiter initially, but quickly attracts the attention of security, and it’s at this moment that the fighting begins. Fitz fends off countless soldiers, and eventually uses explosives to destroy the cooling center that Browstone had been building, thus crushing the company’s plans in the region. He also uses missiles to destroy the entire event space, with only Brownstone operatives left in the space at this point.

Berdasarkan laporan, his actions culminate in a one-on-one showdown with the leader of a group of bosnian mercenaries contracted by brownstone. Initially, his choice comes across as a mistake, as the mercenary gets the upper hand and seemingly has Fitz on the ropes. Despite displaying ruthless tactics against his other opponents, Fitz makes the interesting decision to fight the villain honorably, rather than shooting him dead right away. But unbeknownst to him, Fitz had attached two parts of an explosive device on his back and chest, allowing him to blow an explosive hole in the man's torso.

It was a finishing move that had somewhat of a sci-fi edge to it, but still felt consistent with the technologically advanced arsenal of weapons Fitz had at his disposal throughout the movie.

Sebagaimana diketahui, fitz also had a small helping hand from the recently fired sheriff of the community, olivia thirlby's parker. Having infiltrated the party as well, Parker was able to take on a minor role in the action, including a chance to kill Garret Dillahunt's character when he had Fitz in his sights. Although less skilled than his foreign counterparts, Dillahunt's character made it surprisingly far, but ultimately, none of the villains went unpunished - and that extended to the one power player who managed to keep his distance from the entire conflict.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the closing minutes of the movie, fitz travels to the middle east, where he targets the company’s founder and leader. Fitz uses a sniper rifle to shoot him in the head, thus bringing Brownstone’s reign of terror to a complete end, tying up the last remaining loose end.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it was the methods of the aforementioned villain who made all of this necessary. Desire for full control over the region's water, which would lead to the construction of AI data centers and in turn, a vast increase in the company's wealth, was the driving force of his decision making.

Berdasarkan laporan, as is the case with every ai data center, a significant amount of water is needed in order to keep them going. Brownstone recognizes this and, as such, is actively working to build cooling centers that would help keep the technology at a healthy temperature. For this, the company needs a sizable amount of land, and they had identified the town of Valentine in the countryside of Wyoming as a prime place for their cooling centers.

Diungkapkan bahwa in its efforts to make sense of the lengths they were willing to go to get what they wanted, ghost soldier addressed the matter of imminent domain, a law that enables property to be seized if it serves the good of the community. As characters in the story pointed out, the villains would have had to wait longer than they preferred for imminent domain to kick in, and expectations placed on them to get results spurred them to take matters into their own hands.

Sebagaimana diketahui, brownstone is no more, but fitz still has more to do. Fitz has thus far been lying low in his lab at Wyoming, even when he knows the government could use him elsewhere. His handler in the government, played by Shea Whigham, threatened to pull him out of Wyoming, prompting Fitz to tempt him with a compelling offer. Taking advantage of this, Fitz promised to help deal with international threats if he was allowed to finish the Brownstone fight.

Diungkapkan bahwa presumably, that's what will define fitz's next chapter. It's likely that in the immediate aftermath of Ghost Soldier, Fitz will have his hands full with field work overseas. The United States has all sorts of problems to concern itself with, from Russia to China, which were both brought up in their conversation. That setup could create room for a sequel if the new Jim Caviezel-led action film performs well at the box office.

A reclusive government asset and former Green Beret veteran uses his weapon prototypes to defend rural communities in Wyoming.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the nationwide federal aviation administration shutdown is not connected to microsoft's widespread outage. despite the timing of the two major disruptions raising questions about whether a cyberattack or technical failure could be behind both incidents, according to reports.

NBC News correspondent Tom Winter reports he's been speaking with top law enforcement and cybersecurity officials throughout Friday, and as of 5 PM ET, there's no indication the Microsoft outage has any connection to the FAA problems.

Diungkapkan bahwa winter says officials have found no evidence linking the two incidents, pushing back on speculation that microsoft's technical issues may have played a role in the aviation disruption. The FAA has not publicly confirmed or denied whether the two incidents are related.

The clarification comes amid a chaotic day for travelers, with the FAA's nationwide shutdown raising concerns about flight operations across the country.

As we previously reported, the FAA ordered the unprecedented ground stop Friday afternoon, instructing departing flights at airports nationwide to remain on the ground because of what officials described as an extraordinary circumstance.

Berdasarkan laporan, planes already in the air were allowed to land, while international arrivals were being handled on a case-by-case basis. The order sent airlines and airports scrambling as passengers faced delays and uncertainty about when normal operations would resume.

Diungkapkan bahwa transportation secretary sean duffy said faa technicians were investigating the communications failure. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin also said there was no evidence of a cyberattack or other national security threat, describing the incident as a telecommunications outage.

Berdasarkan laporan, meanwhile, microsoft has been dealing with its own massive outage, which began thursday and affected millions of users worldwide. Outlook, Teams, Copilot, SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 services experienced disruptions, impacting businesses, government agencies and other organizations.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, microsoft has attributed its problems to a technical issue involving a network capacity upgrade and subsequent network changes, saying it found no evidence of malicious or cyber activity. The company had begun restoring services Friday, although some users continued experiencing issues.

Despite the overlap, Winter's reporting suggests the two major outages are separate incidents, with officials not finding evidence that Microsoft's technical problems contributed to the FAA's nationwide shutdown.

The FAA's investigation into the communications failure remains ongoing.

#521. Why Jordan Brand Is Using a ‘Space Jam’ Docuseries to Launch “Jordan TV”

📅 13 Nov 2026

Why Jordan Brand Is Using a ‘Space Jam’ Docuseries to Launch “Jordan TV”

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/digital/beyond-the-jam-space-jam-youtube-docuseries-jordan-brand-1236755122/

The Nike-owned brand is planning to use its Jordan TV platforms to roll out content built around its products, and Michael Jordan himself.

This Sunday, Jordan TV will launch with a buzzy docuseries that takes fans behind the scenes of Space Jam, the live action-cartoon hybrid that debuted in theaters 30 years ago.

The docuseries, Beyond the Jam, features a star-studded cast of characters, from Michael Jordan himself (making a rare on-camera appearance) to stars like Teyana Taylor, J Balvin, and Jayson Tatum, as well as the late Eric Bauza, the voice of Bugs Bunny, who passed away unexpectedly last month.

Berdasarkan laporan, the first episode debuts on the jordan tv youtube channel sunday, with new episodes dropping each week. Warner Bros. worked with Jordan Brand on the docuseries.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “space jam really was more than a movie, it was a cultural movement and really changed the face of the entertainment industry, with an athlete like michael coming in,” says jordan brand cmo caitlin sargent, in an interview with the hollywood reporter. “The last thing you would have expected of an athlete like that would be going and filming a movie. So it was quite unconventional, and I think we always take that as inspiration. He’s our blueprint to say how can we do things a little bit differently?”.

Diungkapkan bahwa “what we decided was to leverage this moment and the story of space jam 30 years, really inspiring the next generation to find their own greatness,” sargent added. “We wanted to use that as a moment to reposition this channel with the six-part mini doc, and the goal here was no doubt to to make sure that we were telling the untold stories of the making of Space Jam, but also the cultural impact it had. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, but it is jordan tv that may be the more intriguing part of the launch. Jordan Brand, the Nike-owned athletics brand known for its iconic “Jumpman” logo, is rethinking content, betting that high-quality original programming, delivered directly to consumers via YouTube, is the future of how it engages with that audience.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i think we know how important storytelling is with the next generation, and we know how important youtube and that channel is,” sargent says. “And so we are working on repositioning our Jordan YouTube channel to Jordan TV, which is really what we’re calling inside access. It’s a one-stop shop destination for never been seen storytelling around product stories and experiences, really allowing our community and our consumer to come inside the walls of the Jordan brand.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “this is our first step out to really reposition the channel, and what you’re going to see is an intersection of sport culture and sneaker culture,” she adds. “But the main piece is that we want to make sure that it does feel like it’s that inside access. I always say, when we’re doing our storytelling, our branded content is always really amazing. But what really our young consumer wants to see is the making of, what was it like to be on set as we’re shooting? What was it like bringing that brand experience to life? And so this will really feel like you’re getting that through several stories that we’ve got coming and that we’re really excited about. ”.

As The Hollywood Reporter reported in an August cover story, brands are becoming more ambitious in their storytelling, looking beyond traditional commercials and campaigns to become more full-funnel storytellers, funding original content, and bringing consumers inside their worlds.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that’s true for nike, which was featured in the story, but also for jordan brand. Sargent describes the move as being an imperative.

Berdasarkan laporan, “we know our consumer has changed, and what creates an emotional connection with youth today is different than what it what it has been over the last 40 years,” she says. “So what we’re doing right now is trying to make sure that we’re shifting into, less branded content. If it feels like an ad, smells like an ad, it starts to fall a bit flat. What we really want to do is shift into a space where we’re creating core memories with our young consumer through the products, through the stories, and through the experiences that we’re putting forth. ”.

#525. HBO’s 5-Part Crime Drama Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History

📅 14 Nov 2026

HBO’s 5-Part Crime Drama Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/the-wire-season-4-recommendation/

The Wire’s fourth season provided a far deeper look at Baltimore’s problems.

The Wire’s fourth season provided a far deeper look at Baltimore’s problems.

Diungkapkan bahwa at the turn of the 21st century, hbo was the place for prestige crime drama. The launch of The Sopranos in 1999 paved the way for the 2002 premiere of The Wire, which focused on drug dealers in Baltimore and the police officers trying to disrupt their operations. The series is still one of the best shows of all time, and provided breakout roles for huge stars like Idris Elba and Michael B. Jordan. But while it was compelling from the beginning, The Wire truly achieved perfection in season 4 when the scope expanded beyond the drug trade to examine the cycle of institutional failure.

Sebagaimana diketahui, season 1 of the wire was tightly focused on the drug empire of avon barksdale (wood harris) and his business-savvy second-in-command stringer bell (elba). Season 2 shifted the focus to the city’s port system, a jarring change as many characters faded into the background to make room for the tragic tale of the Sobotka family. The show could find comedy in something as simple as cops struggling to get new furniture into their office, and then gut audiences with the death of a relatable drug dealer. Showrunner David Simon quickly established a brilliant mix of humor and pathos. Season 3 was the most tightly linked to the show’s first season, largely completing the story of the Barksdale gang.

Berdasarkan laporan, that made season 4 perfect for a soft reboot, a shift that was defined by star dominic west all but disappearing after his relentless detective, jimmy mcnulty, was demoted for pissing off his bosses too many times. criminals beats are familiar, they become just one part of a far more ambitious season that fully capitalized on Simon’s knowledge of the city. (Simon worked as a journalist at The Baltimore Sun for 12 years before creating The Wire. Lester Freamon (Clarke Peters) effectively steps into the McNulty role of pursuing the truth, even when his supervisors would love for him to be a little less dogged, bringing a new methodical nature to the investigations instead of McNulty’s brash confidence. But while the cops vs. The detectives he previously worked with in the major crimes unit continue their work, investigating a vicious new gang that’s filling the void Barksdale left behind. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the season’s largest secondary plot involves the students at a baltimore middle school where former cop roland pryzbylewski (jim true-frost) begins teaching. By the end of season 4, the system has profoundly failed almost all of these kids, driving them to lives of addiction and violence. You want to root for all of them, from the ambitious Randy Wagstaff (Maestro Harrell) to the fiercely protective Michael Lee (Tristan Wilds). The young actors do a phenomenal job establishing likable characters in terrible circumstances. The Wire was always good at making most of its characters sympathetic, but seeing children trapped in such a brutal cycle really drives home the show’s themes of how crime thrives when institutions fail.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that theme also plays out in the mayoral campaign of tommy carcetti (aidan gillen). Gillen’s oily performance as a political survivor who would doom his city to satisfy his own ambitions was what landed him the role of Littlefinger in Game of Thrones. Carcetti was introduced in season 3 as an ambitious city council member, but he really shines in season 4 as he runs on reforming the Baltimore Police Department — and then quickly breaks his promises. Carcetti is even more compelling a character because he feels like a man who could have done good if he’d been willing to make sacrifices rather than feed his own ego.

Diungkapkan bahwa the wire season 4 is able to build so many new arcs because of the strong foundation established in the previous three seasons. The show is dense with rich characters who have grown significantly over the years even as they continue to struggle with many of the same problems. The cops and drug dealers alike feel world-weary as they deal with a more violent new generation represented by Marlo Stanfield (Jamie Hector) and his vicious enforcers Snoop (Felicia Pearson) and Chris Partlow (Gbenga Akinnagbe). Combined with the dark fate of most of the kids and Carcetti’s broken promises, the season creates the bleak feeling that everyone is trapped in a cycle of misery and decay.

Sebagaimana diketahui, season 5 gave most of the wire’s characters satisfying ends to their arcs and delivered a scathing critique of the downfall of american newspapers, commentary that has only become more profound 20 years later. But overall, it’s a big step down from season 4, spending too much time on a goofy fake serial killer plot and not enough on the nuanced character-driven stories that made season 4 feel so authentic. There are no bad seasons of The Wire, but season 4 perfectly achieved the show’s goals. It’s an alternately funny, tragic, and profound look at the complex ways that people are betrayed by systems that never really give them a chance to succeed.

We held off on season 4 until I was sure I could survive. Although there was an article in the Times a week before the COVID shutdown that explicated how vital the NYC DOE was as a social safety net, and that made me feel both great and depressed.

Editor's note: The below contains spoilers for The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 Episode 2.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's likely that the rings of power plotline that longtime fans of j. R. R. Tolkien's larger Middle-earth saga are most invested in is everything regarding Númenor. Certainly one of the draws of exploring the Second Age is seeing this island kingdom at its peak, as well as the inevitable descent into civil unrest between two warring factions vying for the nation's well-being. But only two episodes into its third season, the Prime Video series raises the stakes when Eärien (Ema Horvath), the daughter of Elendil (Lloyd Owen), is discovered as a spy for the Faithful, leading to a harrowing self-sacrifice that no one saw coming.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, eärien's mere existence in the rings of power was an issue for some viewers. Having officially joined the Faithful in the five years between the second season and the third, Eärien works stealthily under Ar-Pharazôn (Trystan Gravelle), feeding intel to her father through her brother Isildur, who has returned home. After all, Elendil is said to have two sons — Isildur (Maxim Baldry) and Anárion (Andrew Richardson), with the latter finally arriving this season — but not a daughter. Created specifically for Prime Video's adaptation, Eärien has always been presented as a woman torn between loyalty and duty, and Season 3 has finally forced her to pick a side, despite the high cost. Upon being discovered, however, she chooses not to betray her family or convictions, but rather to throw herself from Pharazôn's window, a drastic but understandable action that costs her life. Although Rings of Power had finally pushed Eärien to the right side, her sudden demise reminds us that the threat the Faithful are facing is real — and that Númenor is worse off than things may appear on the surface.

From new projects in beloved franchises to festive holiday films.

Berdasarkan laporan, there's an argument to be made that the rings of power has always been at its best when it's given the númenor plot the time of day. From what's revealed up front, it feels as if The Rings of Power aimed to spend the season exploring Isildur and Eärien's strategic rebellion, but all of that quickly changed when Eärien was discovered and thus flung herself onto the streets of Armenelos. Elendil was one of the more interesting and complex characters in the first season, and Tar-Míriel (Cynthia Addai-Robinson) is, naturally, essential to the nation's fate. From the moment viewers return to the island kingdom, the show sets up a game of undercover cat and mouse, as Eärien attempts to balance complex political maneuvers with keeping a low profile. While last season began the conflict between the King's Men faction and the Faithful, Season 3 gives the struggle real legs. Although Eärien refuses to betray her kin or the Faithful, her betrayal has forced Pharazôn's hand, as he aims to wage war against his fellow Númenóreans.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as elendil and míriel wrestle for power against pharazôn, the rings of power seems to be setting up the cataclysm to come. This is exactly what occurs in the vision that Míriel has in the first season after contact with the palantír, and it's undoubtedly where the Prime Video series is heading. This angers Eru Ilúvatar, the God of Tolkien’s world, who not only annihilates Pharazôn and his forces, but, like the biblical Great Flood or the tragedy of Atlantis, sends a massive wave to destroy Númenor itself. In Tolkien's writings, he reveals that Pharazôn eventually forces Míriel to marry him before Sauron (Charlie Vickers) seduces the ruler into a full-scale assault on Valinor to usurp the Valar in an effort to claim eternal life for Men. That said, even with the outcome in mind, how Númenor gets there has always been the most interesting part of that story — with Eärien's demise being one more step toward that ultimate fate.

Berdasarkan laporan, of course, elendil and his sons have a destiny of their own, one that doesn't include their fallen daughter and sister. Elendil would abandon the depraved Númenor to establish the united Kingdoms of Gondor and Arnor, kingdoms his sons would inherit. Not only does Aragorn reunite the fractured kingdoms, but he becomes pivotal in the final defeat of Sauron centuries later. Through this royal lineage, Aragorn is eventually born during the Third Age. Now, it's hard to say when exactly this will all take place in The Rings of Power, but we can rest easy knowing the show has not only firmly set its course, but is now driving full-speed ahead.

New episodes of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power are available for streaming Wednesdays on Prime Video.

Fallout 5 and Fallout Remasters Officially Announced

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/fallout-5-fo3-remaster-new-games-bethesda-softworks/

Diungkapkan bahwa xbox wants more fallout, and after a yearslong drought of new games, bethesda softworks is making it happen. Bethesda plans to release remasters of both Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas for modern platforms, the company said in July in a massive roadmap of the developer's future. Those remasters are part of a larger plan to reinvest in Fallout games — including Fallout 5, which is currently in pre-production — and a new untitled project at Obsidian Entertainment.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we have multiple fallout projects in active development right now," bethesda said in an official announcement this summer. That includes Fallout 5, which is described as the studio's "long-range destination," and "a major Fallout 76 expansion" planned for 2027 called Raven Rock, which will serve as a prequel story to Fallout 3.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bethesda also confirmed two long-standing rumors, announcing remasters for fallout 3 and fallout: new vegas. The studio did not provide any further details or a release window, but the projects have reportedly been in the works for many years. The existence of a Fallout 3 remaster dates back to at least 2020, when the project's existence was revealed through court documents related to the Federal Trade Commission's (FTC) litigation regarding Microsoft's buyout of Activision Blizzard.

Diungkapkan bahwa fallout 3 and fallout: new vegas' remasters follow last year's release of the elder scrolls 4: oblivion remastered, which was co-developed by virtuos and bethesda game studios. Bethesda also marked the 10-year anniversary of Fallout 4 in 2025, with the release of Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition. That rerelease included the original game, all six of the previously released DLC add-ons, as well as over 150 items pulled from the Fallout 4 Creation Club.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fallout 3 was originally released in 2008 for playstation 3, windows pc, and xbox 360. C. The game was the third major installment in the Fallout series, and the first to be developed by Bethesda after acquiring the rights to the franchise from Interplay Entertainment. Fallout 3 is set in and around Washington D. 200 years after a devastating nuclear war, and players control a 19-year-old Vault dweller in search of their missing father.

Diungkapkan bahwa fallout: new vegas followed in 2010, and was developed by obsidian entertainment. It was set in the Mojave Desert and casts players as a courier who becomes embroiled in a conflict between various factions who are vying for control of the region.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in addition to new fallout games, a third season of the fallout tv series is in the works and recently wrapped filming. Bethesda Game Studios is also hard at work on the next game in its fantasy role-playing game series: The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel is now in development.

#535. 12 Best Sci-Fi Movies Released Since Blade Runner, Ranked

📅 14 Nov 2026

12 Best Sci-Fi Movies Released Since Blade Runner, Ranked

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/best-sci-fi-movies-since-blade-runner/

Diungkapkan bahwa in many ways, ridley scott's original blade runner helped redefine what sci-fi movies could achieve both in terms of visual and narrative storytelling, playing a solid role in why the genre is still so prevalent today. Keeping that in mind, it's interesting to look at some of the biggest and best sci-fi movies that have been released in the decades since.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, since 1982's blade runner, plenty of movies have pushed science fiction and its many sub-genres in all kinds of exciting new directions, exploring new concepts and using groundbreaking film-making technologies to create some of the most influential stories ever put on screen. To determine the best sci-fi movies since Blade Runner, this ranking considers factors like overall quality, originality, and overall cultural/lasting impact.

Keeping that in mind, here are 12 of the biggest and best sci-fi movies in the last four decades since Ridley Scott's original Blade Runner, ranked from great to greatest.

Out of all the Star Wars movies released since Blade Runner, George Lucas' Revenge of the Sith feels the most worthy of being on this list, one of the most compelling and beloved sci-fi fantasy blockbusters of the modern era.

Diungkapkan bahwa as the final chapter in the prequel trilogy and the last star wars movie from lucas himself, revenge of the sith details anakin skywalker's tragic transformation into darth vader, bringing the original 6-film skywalker saga full circle with the republic becoming palpatine's galactic empire, as seen in the original trilogy. Despite its dark narrative, Revenge of the Sith features some of the most impressive and memorable sci-fi visuals in the entire Star Wars franchise.

Berdasarkan laporan, time travel has inspired plenty of complicated science-fiction stories over the years, though one of the most entertaining and arguably most accessible is back to the future, directed by robert zemeckis. Transported from 1985 to 1955 in a time-traveling DeLorean, Michael J. Fox's Marty McFly is endlessly entertaining as he attempts to make it back to his own timeline with help from Christopher Lloyd's Doc Brown before his own existence is erased. Across the board, Back to the Future is one of the most perfect sci-fi blockbusters, including its sequels, proving that not every sci-fi has to be so dark and serious.

To this day, Christopher Nolan's Inception has one of the most fascinating sci-fi premises, exploring the idea of infiltrating one's dreams using the classic tropes and concepts of a heist film with professional operatives stealing information from the subconscious, and the unique challenge of planting an idea in a target's head without them realizing it wasn't their own.

Sebagaimana diketahui, starring leonardo dicaprio, joseph gordon levitt, elliot page, tom hardy, and more hollywood legends, inception is easily one of the greatest and most original sci-fi films on this list, one that trusts viewers to keep up with its admittedly complicated ideas for the sake of providing some brilliant visuals as it showcases the "architecture of dreams. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, denis villeneuve's arrival takes the alien invasion premise and turns it on its head, putting the themes of communication and connection at the forefront rather than the typical narratives of violence and humanity being on the brink of extinction. Rather than treating the visiting aliens as straightforward threats, language and its effects on a species serve as the central sci-fi concept, with a linguist played by Amy Adams gradually having her perceptions of time shifted the more she learns their language.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the result is one of the most beautiful and captivating sci-fi films in the modern era. While Arrival might not have the usual fast-paced stakes or conflict seen in other sci-fi epics, Villeneuve still managed to create solid tension all the same.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, thanks to interstellar, christopher nolan absolutely deserves to be on this list twice. An incredibly bold space epic with a mission to save humanity as a dying Earth becomes harder and harder to inhabit, the true dangers of space are on full display with one of the most scientifically accurate sci-fi movies of all time.

Diungkapkan bahwa interstellar is also one of the most emotionally devastating on this list, particularly as matthew mcconaughey's cooper is forced to leave his children behind. Just like in Inception and subsequent films on this list, composer Hans Zimmer further cements himself with Interstellar as a key architect of how sci-fi movies sound in the modern era. The film may have some clunkier dialogue and exposition in some places, though that certainly doesn't keep it from being one of the best sci-fi movies of all time, especially with its massive scale of space and time being contrasted with a strong thematic focus on family throughout.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the terminator is easily one of the most influential science-fiction action movies ever made, introducing audiences to a terrifyingly classic dystopian future where humanity has nearly been wiped out by its own robotic creations. Also featuring time travel, James Cameron's iconic film details the robots' effort to end the war before it can even begin by sending a Terminator back in time to kill the mother of humanity's greatest leader/savior in the future.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the sci-fi premise is brilliantly simple, making for one of the best sci-fi action movies of the 80s, and arnold schwarzenegger's performance made the terminator a huge cinematic icon. Despite its more modest scale, the impressive use of physical effects helped make the world and its mythology incredibly fascinating, and it's no wonder that the movie has generated as many sequel projects as it has.

Diungkapkan bahwa showcasing the dangers of unchecked scientific power in one of the most fantastic ways possible, steven spielberg's jurassic park brought dinosaurs back to life in a way never experienced before. A personal favorite of mine, the blending of groundbreaking visual effects and practical animatronics ensures that the early 90s movie still holds up quite well today. While the movie naturally generated multiple sequels and an entire Jurassic franchise, none have managed to fully rival the original.

Sebagaimana diketahui, james cameron's aliens is perhaps even more impactful on the sci-fi genre than the terminator, the sequel to ridley scott's original film that elevated the original concepts into a major horror-action film. Expanding the Alien universe with new technology, characters, and brand-new ways to make Xenomorphs even more dangerous, Cameron's Aliens is one of the best examples of a sequel finding its own unique identity while still building on the foundation of what made the first entry so captivating in the first place.

Berdasarkan laporan, when we're talking about some of the best sci-fi movies since the original blade runner, it only makes sense to include its epic follow-up with denis villeneuve's blade runner 2049. Another solid example of a sci-fi sequel finding its own unique identity while honoring the original material, 2049 takes place decades after the original, following replicant Blade Runner K (Ryan Gosling) as he uncovers a discovery that could massively change the relationship between humans and artificial life.

Diungkapkan bahwa naturally, k's investigation eventually leads to harrison ford's rick deckard, providing a strong connection to the original film while gosling's performance knocks it out of the park. The cinematography is also on another level, expanding the world and future of the first movie rather than just repeating it.

The Matrix may very well be one of the most perfect sci-fi movies of all time, particularly the first chapter directed by the Wachowskis.

After learning the truth about his life and digital existence, Neo (Keanu Reeves) chooses to wake up to the much harsher reality as "The One" who's capable of changing the dark future humanity has found itself in.

Sebagaimana diketahui, featuring groundbreaking visual effects, reeves remains one of the biggest sci-fi action icons thanks to the matrix for good reason. Featuring several philosophical ideas about reality and free will, the movie goes beyond typical blockbuster spectacle as well, making it one of the most enduring and best sci-fi achievements of all time, much like Blade Runner.

#536. Ex-Cop Sentenced to Chemical Castration After He Was Convicted of Child Rape

📅 13 Nov 2026

Ex-Cop Sentenced to Chemical Castration After He Was Convicted of Child Rape

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.usmagazine.com/crime-news/news/ex-police-officer-convicted-of-child-rape-to-be-castrated/

A former Louisiana police officer and volunteer firefighter convicted of raping children was sentenced to three life prison sentences and castration as an additional punishment.

Berdasarkan laporan, kedreyon k. Williams, of New Roads, was found guilty in October of three counts of first-degree child rape, indecent behavior with a child and possession of pornography involving children following a four-day trial, according to the 18th Judicial District Attorney’s Office.

“A rape conviction automatically carries a mandatory sentence of life in prison, but District Attorney Tony Clayton went a step further and filed the motion for castration,” the office said in a Friday, November 13, news release.

Diungkapkan bahwa in 2024, louisiana became the first state to legalize surgical castration as punishment for people convicted of sex crimes against a child younger than 12, according to the associated press. Louisiana and a few other states also allow for chemical castration in cases involving sex crime convictions.

#540. Bloodborne Just Got A Complete Overhaul On PC

📅 14 Nov 2026

Bloodborne Just Got A Complete Overhaul On PC

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/bloodborne-pc-overhaul-path-tracing-mod/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bloodborne's status as a playstation 4 exclusive has caused no shortage of complaints over the years, especially now that over a decade has passed without any platform update. While it's perfectly functional on the platform, the frame rate could be a lot better, and those without a PS4 have long hoped for it to be more widely available.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the meantime, fans have been making it a lot more accessible on pc. Fans seeking to play it on their computer can choose between either an emulated solution that's received plenty of updates over time or a more recent native decompilation port (which unfortunately made some use of AI in development). If you want to double down on the latter, a new lighting overhaul takes things even further.

Berdasarkan laporan, bloodborne pc path tracing, uploaded to nexus mods by ssoullxx, delivers a full suite of ray-traced features to the unofficial pc port of bloodborne. The description lists its additions as follows: "ray traced moonlight, global illumination, shadows, reflections, puddle mirrors and glass, with DLSS Ray Reconstruction. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the project is currently an alpha build, meaning that not everything will look correct in the new version as it stands. That being said, those who have already played Bloodborne countless times could still appreciate a new look for the game, and future updates might deliver more thoroughly on the potential for a ray-traced version. It's also possible to toggle the overhaul on and off while playing simply by pressing F9, so there's no real commitment involved here.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's certainly been cool to see the community work on bloodborne over the years, but as with many fan projects, recent months have seen a major turn toward ai-assisted coding. On top of the AI assistance involved in the unofficial Bloodborne PC port, the Nexus Mods page for the Path Tracing mod features a disclosure noting that "AI produced the majority of the code, or the UI, or the voice, the dialogue, the translations, music, or other assets. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, opinions on ai coding vary greatly, but there are at least a couple of reasons to think twice before gleefully installing vibe-coded ports or mods. To begin with, AI code is typically going to be less efficient than that of a skilled human programmer, increasing the odds of poor performance or problems that might not be present in 100% human work. The environmental impact of running large language models is also worth considering, especially in light of the sheer volume of projects using AI to generate code.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when it comes to lighting, there's also the simple matter of bespoke design. The original version of Bloodborne features atmospheric lighting from the hands of FromSoft's skilled designers, which even a human-coded ray-tracing mod would run the risk of losing. There's no denying that this mod is a drastic overhaul of Bloodborne, but whether the iconic game is in need of one is a question that anyone considering an installation will have to decide for themselves.

Berdasarkan laporan, “speaking from experience of being in that position [on dwts], i always found that during a season, with the amount of cardio demands on you and the amount of calories that you are burning through in a day with a rigorous schedule,” lindsay explained. “I found it was really hard for me to maintain my muscle definition and tone throughout a season. ”.

#548. Tom Hardy's Ridley Scott Thriller Is The Ultimate Slow-Burn, And Season 2 Can't Come Soon Enough

Tom Hardy's Ridley Scott Thriller Is The Ultimate Slow-Burn, And Season 2 Can't Come Soon Enough

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/tom-hardy-taboo-thriller-series-slow-burn-season-2-in-development/

Diungkapkan bahwa cher thompson is a senior staff writer at screen rant, where she covers everything from explosive reality tv moments to cast interviews about the twists and turns of scripted dramas. With a background in creative writing, marketing, and teaching, Cher knows how to spot both the storytelling genius and the guilty pleasures in pop culture. Her work blends wit with insight, making readers feel like they’re chatting with a friend who just happens to know way too much about TV.

Sebagaimana diketahui, some tv thrillers make their biggest impression through constant action, while others take their time establishing an atmosphere like tom hardy's ridley scott slow burn series, which will be returning for a second season in the near future. While a flash-in-the-pan thriller series can make waves in the short-term, shows that build out their stories and establish a long game can be more interesting to viewers. When all of the elements of a show with a slow burning plot come together, it can be delicious for the audience as a reward for their time spent watching and faith in the writers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this slow burning quality is what makes one of hardy's most distinctive tv projects worth revisiting, especially as the series has a second season coming in the future. The historical thriller, which premiered in 2017 and has remained in the public conversation since, had some struggling with its deliberately slow pacing, while other viewers praised the way that it took on dense storytelling. The series, created by Hardy and his father, Chips, and executive produced by Ridley Scott, follows James Delaney (Hardy) a mysterious adventurer returning to London in the early 1800s to claim an inheritance and confront issues within his father's business.

Berdasarkan laporan, although it's been nearly a decade since the first season of taboo aired in 2017, the show has long been a topic of conversation, especially with the series' second season being confirmed by hardy himself in recent press. While the wait's been long, the journey to Taboo season 2 will surely be well worth the wait.

Berdasarkan laporan, set in 1814, taboo follows hardy's james keziah delaney, an adventurer who returns to london after years in africa left him presumed dead back at home. Word of his father's death brings him back to claim what remains of his family's shipping empire, but James' inheritance isn't exactly straightforward, as the East India Company has their own business interests in the company. Other powerful figures also have their own reasons for keeping Delaney from taking control of the family business, as his return opens old wounds and changes family relationships. As the reasons behind his father's passing are called into question, Delaney's world slowly begins to fall apart.

Diungkapkan bahwa while the show does operate as a period piece due to its timing, it isn't always a conventional one. The version of London that unfurls in Taboo is grim and complicated, focusing on a more corrupt depiction of the city than the reality of what early 19th century London was like. With Hardy's performance anchoring the show, Taboo is able to move within its slow rolling story because his spectacular performance. On top of Hardy, the ensemble cast of the series does a phenomenal job in depicting a fascinating mix of characters in the most difficult of circumstances.

Berdasarkan laporan, after a renewed burst of attention because of a streaming resurgence, taboo is more in demand than it's ever been before. With Delaney and his companions leaving London on the search for their next adventure, the challenges that came with creating another season of Taboo didn't seem too intense when the first season came to a close. The most frustrating part of Taboo's legacy has been the fact that it had a stellar first season and seemed like a series that was determined to continue, but has yet to air another season after its 2017 debut. Thankfully, Hardy himself recently confirmed there was more to come.

Sebagaimana diketahui, despite the unusually long wait between seasons, taboo does seem like it will be back for another season at some point, though there's no filming dates or release window to speak of. Taboo has demonstrated with ease that its long-form storytelling can have a lasting impact, so the amount of time between seasons may simply create more material for the show to work with. Though a second season isn't guaranteed to arrive anytime soon, the series does seem to be a lock for another season in the future. Taboo's return will be another win for Hardy.

#550. Apple TV’s 5-Season Sci-Fi Spectacle Delivers a Masterclass in Worldbuilding

📅 14 Nov 2026

Apple TV’s 5-Season Sci-Fi Spectacle Delivers a Masterclass in Worldbuilding

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://collider.com/for-all-mankind-apple-tv-worldbuilding-masterclass/

Berdasarkan laporan, julio is a senior author for collider. He studied History and International Relations at university, but found his calling in cultural journalism. Having loved movies, music, and TV from an early age, he prides himself in knowing every minute detail about the things he loves. When he isn't writing, Julio also teaches English at a nearby school. He has lived in São Paulo most of his life, where he covers CCXP and other big events. When he is older, he dreams of owning a movie theater in a small countryside town.

Berdasarkan laporan, when watching science fiction, feeling immersed in the story's universe goes a long way in getting the viewer to like it — if you feel like you're part of that world, you'll never forget it. It's set right here, on Earth, over a timeframe that comprises most of our lifetimes, but in a completely different timeline. " And, right now, there is no better sci-fi work to properly understand worldbuilding than Apple TV's For All Mankind. That's the power of worldbuilding, the narrative process through which storytellers create the settings of their stories, from the environment to its "rules. While everything is familiar enough for the viewer to feel "at home," its world is wildly imaginative in how it's built, making this series a true masterclass in this subject.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, right now, the world is experiencing a sort of "space age renaissance" of sorts, but in for all mankind, the space race never ended. Now, NASA and the government need not only to understand why they were beaten, but also to double down on achieving the next big milestone and take the lead. The series begins with the USSR landing a cosmonaut on the Moon before the US, which is enough to set that world on a completely different path from our own. The Soviets also don't want to be overtaken, and so the space race continues.

Berdasarkan laporan, over five seasons, for all mankind explores the increasingly dramatic consequences of this historical divergence. In Season 2, the Moon becomes another battleground in the Cold War. By Season 3, the focus shifts to Mars, with several players competing to become the first to reach it. Each season is set in a different decade, focusing on the next steps of space exploration. In the fourth season, humanity attempts to establish a more permanent presence there, while the fifth examines all the implications of human ambitions beyond Earth.

Sebagaimana diketahui, all that might sound like a lot, but it's actually what the series is really all about: imagining what humanity might have accomplished if the technological and political momentum of the 1960s had continued uninterrupted. Its greatest achievement is making this hypothetical and increasingly extraordinary future feel like the natural consequence of events that began with a single different historical moment. The characters and their stories are the vehicle that takes us there, but the world itself is the main sight.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with such a huge timeframe, for all mankind is more of a generational saga rather than a single individual story, and it's through these people's eyes — especially astronaut ed baldwin (joel kinnaman) and his family — that we experience how different their world becomes from ours. A lot must happen before any rocket can leave the ground, though. That's where most of the worldbuilding takes place and what makes this series so special, as it spends just as much time setting all that up on Earth as it does among the stars.

Berdasarkan laporan, the soviets arriving first on the moon has some serious ramifications. This leads to technological advancements coming to the population much earlier than they do in real life. No US President wants to be the one who "lost the Moon," so investments in space exploration increase on both sides of the Cold War. Personal computers and electric cars are on the market by the 1980s, for example, as well as screens becoming the norm for long-distance communication instead of phones.

Berdasarkan laporan, naturally, the political arena is impacted, too. Space exploration sees the rise of some unlikely heroes on both sides, leading to some crucial (and rather weird) differences from our world. Progressives and conservatives trade places multiple times, with some unlikely candidates becoming world leaders instead of those we learn about in school. Ted Kennedy beats Richard Nixon by cancelling his trip to Chappaquiddick, show character Ellen Wilson (Jodi Balfour) wins the 1992 election over Bill Clinton, and because Ellen wins the election she also pushes forward the legalizing of same-sex marriage in 1998. The series leans into all of the what-ifs of American history without ever lingering too long in any one major change.

Joel Kinnaman as Ed Baldwin and Masha Mashkova as Svetlana Zakharova in a space shuttle cockpit in For All Mankind Season 4.

Joel Kinnaman as Ed Baldwin and Masha Mashkova as Svetlana Zakharova in a space shuttle cockpit in For All Mankind Season 4.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with every new season of for all mankind, an archival-style montage helps to ease the viewers into the new decade, getting them up to speed about everything that happened in the world between one season and the other. With every major development, the series' timeline grows more and more distant from ours, but everything is still rooted in real historical foundations. Regardless of how different things might be, there is always some common ground between fiction and reality, including political personalities and NASA personnel.

Berdasarkan laporan, among the many what-ifs, it's particularly interesting how the series uses real-world events like the rise of tech billionaires in the private sector to add new players to its imagined space race. By the 1990s, they are already a key part of exploration, with enough power to stand up to both the US and the USSR, sometimes even forcing them to cooperate. Soon enough, other space-faring countries also rise to prominence, just as developing countries like the BRICS became important in the international arena in the 2000s, too.

Berdasarkan laporan, worldbuilding in alternate history, like for all mankind, is a challenge in itself, as it demands a solid foundation in reality. Finding the balance between what is real and its plausible imagined ramifications can be tricky, but For All Mankind does it in a way that allows it to become an inspiration instead of a dark mirror. Instead of feeling detached from our world, this makes us even more connected; what separates us from that are only a few different outcomes and decisions, so why not chase them?.

For All Mankind is streaming on Apple TV.

Investigators have identified the second of two women found buried in a shallow grave in the dirt floor of a basement nearly 40 years after the discovery.

Diungkapkan bahwa forensic genetic genealogy identified the woman as toni l. Gordon, a 31-year-old Nashville resident who was discovered in 1987 in the basement of a home rented by her killer, James Shaffer, the Metropolitan Nashville Police Department announced in a Monday, November 9, news release.

Gordon was buried alongside another woman, identified in 2025 as 23-year-old Sheila Cummings, in the dirt floor of the basement in Nashville, according to police.

Their identities remained a mystery, with Shaffer only referring to Gordon as “Lil’ Bit,” police said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, shaffer confessed to the murders following the discovery of their bodies and was sentenced to serve two life sentences, according to police. He died behind bars in 2004.

“Family members believed that Gordon moved out of state and lost contact with them,” police said in the news release.

Authorities notified them of the identification of her remains.

By the time a tenant discovered both women’s skeletal remains at the Nashville home, Shaffer was imprisoned in Kentucky in connection with the rape and kidnapping of a teenage boy, according to the Nashville Banner.

When Shaffer confessed to the killings, he claimed the women were sex workers and that he murdered them out of anger when he discovered they had allegedly tried to steal something from him, the news outlet reported.

In January 2025, the remains of both Gordon and Cummings were exhumed for a forensic analysis, The Tennessean reported.

Cummings, who was from Elgin, Illinois, was identified months later after a DNA sample was collected from her adult daughter, according to the newspaper.

The woman had previously called cold case investigators about her missing mother, who she said vanished in 1984, the newspaper reported.

Nashville police worked with DNA Investigative Solutions, Bode Technology, the National Missing & Unidentified Persons System, a medical examiner’s office and the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation to identify both women.

In addition to disclosing her daughter’s cancer battle, Aspyn opened up about her divorce from Parker and entering into a throuple with married duo Bri and Billy Davis.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i had a lot of reassurance from production that they would be very respectful of my life and my story,” aspyn told us. “I got to have a hand in crafting my story and the way that they put everything together. Diungkapkan bahwa “i think my goal was to have people see elizabeth,” evans said, while acknowledging how the final product made him appear “conniving” to audiences. “When I watch that movie, I see the person that I love and exactly who she is. ”.

#562. Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt's Daughter Vivienne Reveals Eating Disorder Battle

Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt’s daughter Vivienne bared her soul through art while revealing she was hospitalized for an eating disorder earlier this year.

The 18-year-old opened up about her private health battle as part of her Los Angeles art exhibition titled “The Tulip Field: A Gallery on Patience of Patients,” displayed from November 2 through November 8 at Forager Crafts.

Berdasarkan laporan, “welcome to the tulip field,” vivienne wrote in a statement at the exhibit via page six. “Why is it called The Tulip Field, you ask? Like many, I have struggled with mental health. I have also struggled with an eating disorder. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa she recalled, “at the beginning of this year, i was hospitalized for my ed. I was angry, sick, and very alone. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, vivienne, who is one of jolie and pitt’s six children, revealed that with time she embraced the people and the environment at the hospital. (In addition to Vivienne and her twin brother, Knox, the former couple also share kids Maddox, Zahara, Shiloh and Pax. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, “eventually, however, the kindness and warmth of the kids and staff at the hospital broke down the walls i had built so high,” she wrote. “I have never laughed or cried harder, never been more honest or more myself. ”.

Vivienne noted that it was the other kids at the hospital who helped her find her strength.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “the other kids there taught me how to be strong when you are at your weakest,” she continued. “It was the worst and best time of my life and I am better for it. ”.

Vivienne shared with artgoers that the exhibit was meant to document her time at the hospital and how it transformed her life.

Berdasarkan laporan, “the tulip field is what i call the hospital and the paintings here represent moments in time spent there,” she wrote. “Moments of hopelessness, moments I couldn’t stop laughing, moments of safety, moments of bravery. ”.

The Maleficent actress explained that there were no photographs taken during her hospitalization, so the artwork is a way to depict the feelings and emotions she experienced along with the other patients.

Berdasarkan laporan, “these are our memories, our purest memories, preserved,” vivienne added. “The title of each painting is a sentence I took from journal entries I wrote during my time at the hospital, from passages I felt best fit the paintings. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one painting, titled “vitals,” showed a tulip in a hospital room getting their vitals taken. It featured a handwritten note dated May 14, 2026, that read, “I feel guilty for needing to be in the hospital this long. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a separate piece titled “sleph’s star,” depicted two tulips staring up at a gold star. The handwritten message read, “We all went to the deck last night. ”.

Us has reached out to reps for Jolie and Pitt for comment.

Vivienne’s exhibit opened the same day Us confirmed that a judge in Los Angeles granted her petition to legally change her name from Vivienne Marcheline Jolie-Pitt to Vivienne Marcheline Jolie.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, vivienne is the fourth of jolie and pitt’s children to drop the fight club actor’s moniker since the couple split in september 2016. The exes were married two years and didn’t finalize their divorce until December 2024.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you or someone you know struggles with an eating disorder, visit the national alliance for eating disorders website or call their hotline at (866) 662-1235. Text “ALLIANCE” to 741741 for free, 24/7 support.
