#564. ‘Fatherland,’ ‘La Bola Negra,’ ‘Fjord’ Lead European Film Award Nominations

📅 14 Nov 2026

‘Fatherland,’ ‘La Bola Negra,’ ‘Fjord’ Lead European Film Award Nominations

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/fatherland-la-bola-negra-european-film-award-nominations-1236754942/

Sandra Hüller scored a dual best actress nom for 'Fatherland' and 'Rose,' with Renate Reinsve, Sebastian Stan, Penelope Cruz, Javier Bardem and Andrew Scott among the acting nominees.

Pawel Pawlikowski’s German black-and-white period drama Fatherland, and La Bola Negra, a gay Spanish epic from director Javier Ambrossi and Javier Calvo, are the frontrunners for the 2027 European Film Awards, with Fatherland racking up 11 EFA nominations to 10 for La Bola Negra.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, both fatherland and la bola negra picked up efa noms in the best european film, european director, european screenwriter and european cinematographer categories, with fatherland also receiving european actress and european actor noms for leads hanns zischler and sandra hüller for their performances, respectively, as nobel prize-winning writer thomas mann and daughter erika. Related Stories Movies Modern Fairy Tale 'Mo Amor' Explores Identity, Transformation and Love in All Its Forms Movies 5 Takeaways From China's Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival.

Berdasarkan laporan, hüller received a second best european actress nom, for her starring role as a 17th-century woman masquerading as a man in markus schleinzer’s rose. She’s going up against Penélope Cruz, nominated for Florian Zeller’s Bunker; Léa Seydoux for her leading role in Marie Kreutzer’s Gentle Monster; Mathilde Arcel for her performance in May el-Toukhy’s Venice Festival winner Woman Unknown; and Renate Reinsve for her starring role in Cristian Mungiu’s Palme d’Or-winning Fjord.

Sebastian Stan, who plays Reinsve’s fundamentalist Christian husband in Fjord, received a best European actor nomination, alongside Zischler; Javier Bardem, nominated for Rodrigo Sorogoyen’s The Beloved; Swann Arlaud for his turn in Emmanuel Marre’s A Man of His Time; and Andrew Scott, nominated for his performance in Simon Stone’s Elsinore as Ian Charleson, the British actor dying of AIDS who throws himself into a final performance of Hamlet.

Nominated for best European film, alongside Fatherland and La Bola Negra, are Fjord, Woman Unknown and La Gradiva, a French coming-of-age drama from first-time director Marine Atlan.

Best European director nominees, alongside Pawlikowski and Ambrossi/Calvo, are Mungiu for Fjord, Sandra Wollner for the German drama Everytime and Andrey Zvyagintsev for the Russian crime thriller Minotaur.

The European Animation Film nominees are: In Waves, directed by Phuong Mai Nguyen; Iron Boy from Louis Clichy; Jim Queen, directed by Marco Nguyen and Nicolas Athané; Lucy Lost, directed by Olivier Clert; and Viva Carmen from Sébastien Laudenbach.

Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor’s NAZA, an exposé of Israel’s war in Gaza, produced by The Guardian and Britain’s JW Films, was nominated for best European documentary, alongside Letters From the Silenced Country from director Andrei Kutsila; Pegah Ahangarani’s Rehearsals for a Revolution; To Hold a Mountain from directors Biljana Tutorov and Petar Glomazić; and Whispers in the Woods, directed by Vincent Munier.

All of the best animation and best documentary nominees are also nominated in the best European film category.

Berdasarkan laporan, the 39th european film awards will be held in athens on jan. 16, 2027.

#565. Cinephil Boards Alexandru Solomon’s Romanian Election Doc ‘Small Expectations’ – IDFA

📅 14 Nov 2026

Cinephil Boards Alexandru Solomon’s Romanian Election Doc ‘Small Expectations’ – IDFA

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://deadline.com/2026/11/cinephil-alexandru-solomon-small-expectations-idfa-1237223722/

EXCLUSIVE: Doc sales specialist Cinephil has boarded Alexandru Solomon’s Small Expectations ahead of its world premiere in the Frontlight sidebar of the International Documentary Film Festival Amsterdam next week.

The first-person investigation chronicles the chaotic lead-up to Romania’s 2025 presidential election in which moderate independent Nicușor Dan faced off against far-right forces, including Trump-aligned street fighter George Simion and ultranationalist Călin Georgescu.

Diungkapkan bahwa solomon delves into the machinery of power, disinformation, and the rapid radicalization of a society under pressure, as russian interference allegations, institutional breakdowns, and the unleashing of fascist energy left romania’s democracy exposed. Related Stories Documentary IDFA Artistic Director Isabel Arrate Fernandez On Festival's Competition Lineups, "Huge" Interest In Elizabeth Holmes Doc, And AI In Documentaries Acquisitions Lightdox Acquires Sales Rights To IDFA World Premiere 'The Big Boom!', Gabriel Tejedor Film With Explosive Contradictions.

Sebagaimana diketahui, production is led by award-winning romanian company microfilm, headed by ada solomon, current chair of the european film academy board, in co-production with belgium’s while we’re here (frederik nicolai and annabel verbeke). Watch on Deadline.

“Following the particular case of the Romanian elections, the film is talking about very serious matters but using an approach that we wanted vivid, unconventional and entertaining at the same time,” said Alexandru Solomon and Ada Solomon in a joint statement.

Berdasarkan laporan, “we are super excited to team up with cinephil and we are confident that we have the right partners for the international journey of the film. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa alexandru solomon is one of romania’s top documentarians. After starting out as a cinematographer for fiction films in the 990s and collaborating with other artists on experimental works, he shifted his focus to documentaries.

Diungkapkan bahwa his feature documentaries include the great communist robbery (2004), cold waves – war on radio (2007), kapitalism, our secret recipe (2010), tarzan’s testicle (2017). His work has played at film festivals including IDFA, Karlovy Vary, IFFR Rotterdam, been nominated for European Film Awards and won several national awards at home.

His most recent film, Arsenie, An Amazing Life (2023) premiered in Karlovy Vary IFF and was screened in IDFA, Valladolid and ZagrebDox, among others.

Alongside making documentaries, Soloman also teaches at University of Arts – UNArte, Bucharest, and is the president of One World Romania Association in charge of the homonym film festival, the only human rights dedicated film festival in Romania.

Berdasarkan laporan, “few directors have mapped the fault lines of contemporary romania with the consistency, courage, and cinematic intelligence of alexandru solomon. We’re honored to be collaborating with him and his team to bring Small Expectations to audiences,” said Shoshi Korman and Suzanne Nodale, co-Managing Directors of Cinephil.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “as so many countries are facing the same challenges and upcoming elections around the world, the film acts as a cautionary tale of the fragility of our democracies in an ever more connected world. ”.

Further partners include the Centrul Național al Cinematografiei (CNC), Flemish public broadcaster VRT, Romanian public broadcaster TVR, and Avanpost Media.

#572. Modern Fairy Tale ‘Mo Amor’ Explores Identity, Transformation and Love in All Its Forms

📅 14 Nov 2026

Modern Fairy Tale ‘Mo Amor’ Explores Identity, Transformation and Love in All Its Forms

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/trans-fairy-tale-mo-amor-explores-love-tallinn-2026-estonia-1236753723/

Estonian director Eeva Mägi is back at the Tallinn Black Nights Film Fest with her tender new film about a photographer, Princess Niina and her three suitors: The Mentor, The Writer and The Stonemason.

Sebagaimana diketahui, once upon a time… princess niina lived in her castle. She was courted by three suitors: The Mentor, The Writer and The Stonemason. This is, more or less, how the film Mo Amor, a tender, modern and very timely Estonian fairy tale about love in all its forms and identity, begins. And it is about to get its world premiere at the 30th edition of the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF).

Sebagaimana diketahui, writer-director eeva mägi (mo mamma, mo papa, the weight of all the beauty) and her creative collaborators present a cinematic story told by a photographer named kaur. Inviting her former lovers to a secluded summer home, the stage is set for a strange reunion where memory, myth, and reality begin to intertwine, old wounds resurface, and love takes unexpected forms. “Princess Niina is adored by three suitors, yet remains restless, searching for something she cannot quite name,” teases a synopsis on the PÖFF website. “Then she sheds her crown and reveals her true self. ” Related Stories Movies 5 Takeaways From China's Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival Movies Joel Kinnaman to Star in Creature Thriller 'The Cell' for 'Sleeping Dogs' Director Adam Cooper (Exclusive).

Diungkapkan bahwa mo amor gets its world premiere on monday, nov. 16, in the Critics’ Picks Competition of the festival. Mägi’s previous film, Mo Papa, opened Tallinn’s Critics’ Picks section last year and earned a special mention.

Berdasarkan laporan, mägi wrote and directed the film and produced it with sten-johan lill, who also handled the cinematography. The editor was Jette Keedus. The cast features Mo Papa stars Ester Kuntu and Jarmo Reha, one of this year’s 10 rising stars in Tallinn’s Black Nights Stars showcase, as well as Tambet Tuisk, Andres Mähar, Sander Roosimägi and Ivor Mikker.

Ahead of the film’s Tallinn world premiere, Mägi talked to THR about the inspiration for the film, how identity is used in political rhetoric and the lyrical quality of Mo Amor.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “i always have personal stories intertwined with stories that i want to tell for society or that society needs to be told,” the filmmaker shares about her inspiration for the new movie. But then also, transgender people are facing so many obstacles, at least in Estonia, and society is still very prejudicial towards them. “I had this idea about what if love actually survives the truth, since we lie so much to people we love just to pretend we’re someone else or are sometimes so afraid to reveal who we are. So I wanted to tell a universal love story, make a transgender person a hero and show a trans man’s fairy tale. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, mägi also emphasizes: “of course, there is no such thing as transgender love and ordinary love. It is all just pure love. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the idea to tell the journey of self-discovery and transformation that niina goes on came organically in the filmmaking process. “And it also shows that everything is possible. “I thought it would be even more powerful if I told it as a fairy tale because fairy tales allow us to talk about very difficult topics in very beautiful and universal ways,” she tells THR. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i had the feeling that it had to be a fairy tale because this story in our society is still being seen as a fairy tale – people don’t think it’s realistic. But I think we have to tell these fairy tales until they become part of our real life. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, mägi loves bringing back collaborators from her past films because she shoots with a small budget and a very open process without a pre-written script that allows the creative team to explore the characters and storylines and see where the discovery process takes them. Tambet Tuisk, who’s playing The Writer, was in two of my previous short films, and he’s also part of Mo Hunt, which is my next feature film – and Jarmo is there again, too. So, these actors and others [on the production] are already used to my method. “I’ve been working with the same actors and actresses for years now,” she explains. “Both Jarmo Reha, who is Kaur, and Ester Kuntu, who’s playing Niina, were also in Mo Papa. We are all surfing on the same wave of chaos. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, mikker is not a professional actor, so how did he end up in mo amor? “i met him at a bar,” the writer-director shares. He’s studying sculpture at the Estonian Arts Academy. “He’s my friend. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, was there an option to cast a trans actor for the film? “we couldn’t find a transgender actor to play in the film because we don’t have any [in estonia],” the writer-director explains. And we are not so much concentrating on the transition period. “So, I talked to the trans community, and they thought that it was okay if Ester, as a woman, is playing Niina and Jarmo, as a man, is playing Kaur. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that was also by choice. “We didn’t want to concentrate on the transitioning period and use a lot of makeup and do all these stereotypical things that a lot of films do,” Mägi tells THR.

Diungkapkan bahwa what mo amor does feature, though, is recurring photo camera sounds followed by still frames before the “action” or moving images continue. “And when we started shooting, I realized that I wanted to have these still frames because Niina/Kaur is a photographer. “The process itself is always guiding us,” the filmmaker emphasizes. I wanted to somehow make the film reflect this profession and use it as part of the cinematic storytelling. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa mo amor was shot over the course of 17 days at the filmmaker’s boathouse on vilsandi island in the baltic sea, estonia’s westernmost populated island. “It’s very cinematic. And as we didn’t have any budget, as always, I decided to basically shoot it at home. “This place is amazing,” the creative says about the island. ”.

What can she share about her next feature, the briefly mentioned Mo Hunt? “We are in post- production at the moment,” she says.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and just like mo papa and mo amor are very different in terms of look, feel and atmosphere, mo hunt will also be a different kind of experience. “It’s a hybrid film, a staged documentary. I don’t want to repeat myself. And it’s also the outcome of the fact that we don’t have everything planned. And I guess every story has its unique ways of being reflected. We really go into the process and let the story guide us. “The visual language is different,” Mägi tells THR. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the original idea for mo hunt was to tell the story of a ballerina who becomes an illegal surrogate. “Artistic creation can become exploitation or mental abuse. I was wondering how far I can push actors just for the sake of art. I understood that there are boundaries, there are limits. “We started staging this ballerina, and then I had a feeling that I had to collect stories from different artists about how they have experienced the thin line between artistic creation and manipulation,” the director recalls. So, then I started to get interested in this topic and started collecting different stories from different artists. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that is why mo hunt will be “a staged documentary. ” Explains Mägi: “All the people in the film are playing actors, but they are presenting the stories of different artists. So, the film combines what’s happening in the fiction film with what’s actually happening in artists’ hearts and minds. ”.

#573. European Film Awards: ‘Fatherland’ & ‘La Bola Negra’ Top Nominations – Full List Of Films & Credits

📅 14 Nov 2026

European Film Awards: ‘Fatherland’ & ‘La Bola Negra’ Top Nominations – Full List Of Films & Credits

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://deadline.com/2026/11/european-film-awards-2026-nominations-1237223704/

The European Film Academy has unveiled the nominations in the 16 key categories of its 39th European Film Awards taking place in Greece in January 2027.

Paweł Pawlikowski’s Fatherland leads the nominations, making it into 11 categories, followed by Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi’s La Bola Negra with ten nominations and Cristian Mungiu’s Cannes Palme d’Or winner Fjord with five.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the nominations were announced in front of a live audience on saturday at the pavlos zannas theatre in the iconic olympian building in thessaloniki, as part of the thessaloniki international film festival. Related Stories News London Film Festival: 'La Bola Negra' Wins Audience Award News 'La Bola Negra' Caliente At Box Office With $43M Worldwide, Becomes Spain's Top-Grossing Local Pic Of 2026.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the winners will be unveiled at an awards ceremony on january 16 at the stavros niarchos foundation cultural center in athens, greece, co-organised by the european film academy and the ηellenic film and audiovisual center. Watch on Deadline.

The nominations are based on the votes of 5,700 members of the European Film Academy who have been watching the films included in the annual European Film Awards Shortlist, and will now vote for the winners.

Pawlikowski’s first film in eight years, Cold War drama Fatherland stars Hanns Zischler and Sandra Hüller as writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika as they travel across Germany in 1949 from Frankfurt in West Germany to Weimar, East Germany.

The Polish filmmaker shared the Cannes Best Director prize in May with Calvo and Ambrossi, whose La Bola Negra is one of the frontrunners across the award season this year.

Revolving around the interconnected stories of three gay men in 1932, 1937 and 2017, La Bola Negra has been raking in audience awards and storming the box office at home and internationally since its Cannes world premiere and Best Director win.

Mungiu’s Fjord, starring Sebastian Stan and Renate Reinsve as a Romanian and Norwegian couple whose plans for a new life in a fjord village come up against neighbors with a very different outlook on life, won the director his second Cannes Palme d’Or this year, after 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days in 2007.

Fifteen films have garnered a nomination in the European Film category spanning fiction, documentary and animation.

Previous recent winners in the category have included Best International Feature Film Oscar winners Another Round and Sentimental Value as well as Quo Vadis, Aida?, Triangle of Sadness and Anatomy of a Fall, which won the Best Original Screenplay Academy Award.

Diungkapkan bahwa a number of documentaries have been nominated for best documentary and best film including bombshell exposé naza, french box office break out whispers in the woods and letters from a silenced country. Best Animation nominees also making it into the Best Film category include festival breakouts In Waves, Iron Boy and Jim Queen.

The upcoming ceremony in Greece will be the second time the European Film Awards take place in a new January slot as part of a strategy to place them at the heart of the wider awards season, having taken place in December for many years.

Berdasarkan laporan, the january 16, 2027 slot once again falls the day after the end of nomination voting in the academy awards on january 15, and before the january 21 nominations announcement. This gives European talents in the running for the Oscars time to return home to Europe for the awards. The Golden Globes will also be done and dusted with its 2027 ceremony set for January 10.

#575. ‘Hen’ Review: A Resilient Chicken Flies the Coop, Over and Over, in an Unexpectedly Stirring Survival Story

📅 14 Nov 2026

‘Hen’ Review: A Resilient Chicken Flies the Coop, Over and Over, in an Unexpectedly Stirring Survival Story

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://variety.com/2026/film/news/hen-review-1236947197/

Like 'Au Hasard Balthasar' for the humblest of barnyard animals, Hungarian director György Pálfi's film is a remarkable technical and logistical feat, but so emotionally involving you almost forget to notice.

Sebagaimana diketahui, why did the chicken cross the road? in “hen,” the answer is, as ever, to get to the other side. But it’s not the miraculous novelty of the production that crosses your mind as you’re watching: In the moment, your heart pounds for that poor, dumb but surprisingly resourceful chicken, and you lock completely into her simultaneously small and vast survival saga. But the stakes are a little higher and more urgent than that in György Pálfi unassuming marvel of a creature feature: When its gallinaceous protagonist is forced across a busy highway, it’s because a hungry fox is very much on her tailfeathers. That hunter and prey in this scenario are both played by real live animals is a large part what makes “Hen” riveting: Made without CGI, with a predominantly non-human ensemble that includes eight fowl playing the lead role alone, it’s a sustained cinematic feat of fauna-wrangling unlike any other. Related Stories Is ‘I Play Rocky’ Original or Adapted? Stallone’s ‘Rocky’ Origin Story Faces a ‘Barbie’-Style Oscar Dilemma (EXCLUSIVE) 'I Play Rocky' Star Anthony Ippolito on Becoming Sylvester Stallone and Acting With a Dog: 'He Wasn't a Huge Fan of Me'.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, coming from most filmmakers, “hen” — which premiered in toronto’s platform competition last year, earning an honorable mention from the jury — would count as an eccentric project. But from Hungarian auteur Pálfi, whose consistently experimental oeuvre includes 2006’s Cannes-selected, shape-shifting body horror “Taxidermia” and 2018’s labyrinthine mixed-media Stanislaw Lem adaptation “His Master’s Voice,” this may be the most narratively conventional film he’s ever assembled: a grandly linear hero’s journey in which the hero just happens to be a resplendently scarlet-combed and treacle-plumed chicken, whose antagonists along the way run the gamut from wild predators to human traffickers. No life form is given precedence over another, as “Hen” limns a tense dog-eat-dog-eat-bird ecosystem — the world we all know and struggle through, just from a different vantage point.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the hen in question remains nameless and voiceless from beginning to end — though the birds playing her all get star billing by name in the closing credits. ) Pálfi has little interest in directly anthropomorphic storytelling, and while his film is a rather eventfully scripted fiction, it aims for documentary-style naturalism and spontaneity. (Eszti, Szandi, Feri, Enci, Eti, Enikő, Nóra and Anett, to give them their due. The obvious recent comparison point is Jerzy Skolimowski’s Oscar-nominated donkey odyssey “EO,” minus that film’s more expressionistic flourishes; Robert Bresson’s “Au Hasard Balthasar,” too, minus at least some of its despairing tragedy.

Berdasarkan laporan, it begins in a cramped industrial farm somewhere in rural greece, where the hen’s life begins with a startlingly graphic egg-laying scene. (If you’ve ever wondered what a chicken’s cloaca looks like up close, Pálfi has you covered. ) After the fledgling chick cracks her way into the outside world — standing out from the vast crowd with her uniformly dark plumage — she soon learns the cruel ways of commercial poultry-rearing and, in time, seeks a different destiny. A heart-in-mouth chain of circumstances enables her escape; via a serious of perilous scrapes, she eventually winds up at a coastal smallholding, owned by a family who get by running a shabby café on the premises, alongside other, less legal activities.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there, she finds herself trapped again in the owners’ chicken coop, and put to work laying eggs: a less grim fate than the one that awaited her in the farm where she was born, perhaps, but an unhappy one just the same. Though Pálfi lightens matters with some droll music cues — the coop’s resident rooster is introduced to the grandiose strains of a romantic ballad by Greek favorite Grigoris Mpithikotsis — the film doesn’t shy from the traumatizing impact of what effectively amounts, for our feathered heroine, to recurring sexual assault, and the repeated theft of her eggs.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and so she escapes, thrillingly, and more than once — motivated, it seems, by little more than some unknowing, unspoken sense that there has to be something else out there for her. In a particularly dark stab of irony, a key chance at liberation comes via her owners’ reckless venture into the trafficking of refugees. Though “Hen” maintains a sly comic sensibility throughout, there’s solemn substance to how it shows the interconnected abuse of human and animal rights alike, adding up to a portrait of a world sliding off its moral axis.

Berdasarkan laporan, that deft command and calibration of tone is as remarkable as the film’s seamless technical fluency, with every below-the-line contribution vital in cleaving to the chicken’s perspective. Vividly detailed sound design keeps us in her tiny headspace; ditto Giorgos Karvelas’ lithe, nimble cinematography, fully alert to her rhythm of movement and occasional, unpredictable moments of flighty rebellion. Editor Lehmhényi Réka, meanwhile, achieves the extraordinary feat of forging one coherent and characterful performance from footage of multiple birds — a patchworked star turn that invites and earns our complete emotional investment. A madly impractical and richly felt vision that pretty much required Pálfi to put all his eggs in one basket, “Hen” is a risk that pays off in heartening style.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “what we aim to do is to bring the city together and push together and rally support behind the festival, working hard with local and regional entities, local government, and private initiatives and citizens. #588. 7 Major Movie Twists That Happen Shockingly Early, Ranked

📅 14 Nov 2026

7 Major Movie Twists That Happen Shockingly Early, Ranked

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/movies-plot-twists-happen-early/

Major spoilers ahead for all seven movies.

Sebagaimana diketahui, most movies save their biggest surprise for the end. It's a tried-and-tested arrangement, and the best plot twists in crime movies demonstrate how satisfying a properly timed disclosure can be. The audience suspects the wrong person until a final-act revelation upends everything. But there's something especially audacious about dropping the bombshell while most of the story is still ahead.

Sebagaimana diketahui, alfred hitchcock knew that better than almost anyone. In Psycho, he spent nearly half a movie encouraging viewers to follow Janet Leigh's troubled heroine before disposing of her in the shower. The scene was horrifying, but the real trick was what happened afterward: a story that appeared to be about stolen money suddenly had no thief to follow.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, an early twist creates a problem for the filmmaker. Killing someone in the opening minutes doesn't automatically qualify, either. Plenty of horror movies do that. Once the surprise is out, there has to be enough compelling material left to justify the decision. The more interesting question is whether the reveal forces viewers to reconsider the kind of film they're watching.

Diungkapkan bahwa that's the principle behind this ranking. What counts most is how radically the reveal changes the story and how convincingly the film follows through. Timing matters, but the entries aren't ordered by a stopwatch. A clever genre switch can be tremendous fun without being as consequential as losing the character we've been encouraged to treat as the lead.

Sebagaimana diketahui, some of these surprises were practically advertised in advance, which complicates matters. Others remained closely guarded secrets. Either way, the best early twists don't finish the puzzle. They make audiences realize they've been trying to solve the wrong one.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fresh starts like a romantic comedy. Then, about half an hour into the film, he drugs her and reveals that he sells women's flesh to wealthy cannibals. Noa (Daisy Edgar-Jones), defeated by dating apps, meets a charming doctor named Steve (Sebastian Stan) at the grocery store. Well, that explains why the first date went so smoothly.

Berdasarkan laporan, director mimi cave makes the transformation part of the film's design. The opening credits don't appear until around the 30-minute mark, as though the seemingly agreeable romance has been a feature-length practical joke on Noa. Suddenly, Steve's earlier charm looks less like flirtation and more like the sales technique of a man who knows exactly how to gain someone's trust.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the turn is brilliantly staged, and the rest becomes a nasty exercise in survival horror. Yet the marketing and growing unease have hinted that something dreadful is coming. Fresh conceals the nature of its horror without making audiences rethink whose story they're watching. That's a terrific trick, but the movies above take bigger structural risks.

Diungkapkan bahwa wes craven put scream's biggest star in the opening scene, then killed her before the story had properly begun. Drew Barrymore's Casey Becker is murdered by Ghostface roughly 12 minutes in, despite the actress's prominence in the marketing. Anyone assuming her celebrity came with plot armor was in for a very unpleasant surprise.

Diungkapkan bahwa craven builds the sequence around a phone call that stops being playful. Casey's horror-movie knowledge offers no protection, and Barrymore makes the ordeal frightening. The opening established the tone that helped make Scream one of the essential '90s horror movies. It also made a promise the franchise still works to keep: knowing the rules won't necessarily save anybody.

Berdasarkan laporan, the distinction from psycho matters. Hitchcock waits long enough to establish another movie before taking its protagonist away. Scream dispatches its supposed star before viewers have settled into the main narrative; Casey's murder effectively launches Sidney Prescott's story. Barrymore's exit is an ingenious opening ambush, but it doesn't overturn an entire story already in progress.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, imagine paying for a whodunit and being told who did it before you've formed a theory. After novelist Harlan Thrombey (Christopher Plummer) is found dead, a flashback reveals that his nurse, Marta Cabrera (Ana de Armas), apparently gave him a lethal dose of morphine by mistake. Rian Johnson comes close in Knives Out. Harlan takes his own life to protect her.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that supposed solution turns the mystery inside out. Johnson persuades viewers to side with Marta, turning a delightful detective into the person they desperately hope will fail. Detective Benoit Blanc (Daniel Craig) is still investigating, but the audience knows more than he does. Every innocent question Blanc asks carries the threat of ruining her life.

Sebagaimana diketahui, johnson's sleight of hand is more sophisticated than a simple early reveal, because the film later complicates what we thought we witnessed. He uses the apparent answer to make us emotionally invested in a possible culprit. The twist powers much of the movie rather than simply launching the plot.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's cleverer than an opening ambush, but the revelation ultimately becomes another layer of misdirection. The remaining films leave their characters with consequences that cannot be undone.

Sebagaimana diketahui, arnold schwarzenegger spent the terminator trying to murder sarah connor. When he returns as another T-800 in James Cameron's sequel, her son John (Edward Furlong) seems equally endangered. Cameron encourages that assumption by introducing a second time traveler who looks like a police officer. Then the two machines converge on John in a shopping mall.

Berdasarkan laporan, the t-800 protects the boy. The officer, played by Robert Patrick, is the real killer: an advanced T-1000. The reversal creates room for the relationship that gives Terminator 2 its emotional force. In a moment, the monster from the original becomes the sequel's unlikely hero. John begins teaching a machine why humans matter.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there's a fair argument against placing the twist higher. Cameron deliberately showed Schwarzenegger as the protector in the trailers, deciding that the reversal was a selling point rather than a secret to preserve. Plenty of 1991 moviegoers knew the truth before entering the theater.

Berdasarkan laporan, even with that disadvantage, the first-act reveal rewrites the franchise's central relationship. The boy who would have fled from Arnold in the original now refuses to abandon him. Few sequels have repurposed an iconic villain so successfully.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ryan gosling is the face of the place beyond the pines, and for nearly its first hour the movie belongs to him. Luke Glanton is a motorcycle stunt rider who begins robbing banks to support his infant son. Derek Cianfrance suggests a crime drama about a flawed man trying to become a father.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, then rookie police officer avery cross (bradley cooper) shoots luke dead. The film doesn't invent a way to bring Gosling back or hurry toward a conclusion. It follows Avery, then jumps ahead to the lives of both men's sons. Luke's death transforms a familiar rise-and-fall narrative into something much more unsettling about inheritance.

Sebagaimana diketahui, cianfrance has explicitly credited psycho with inspiring this approach. Hitchcock's ability to pass the story from one apparent protagonist to another stayed with him, and he adapted the idea to a film about the effects of choices across generations. There's an unusual confidence in asking an audience to keep investing after the marquee star disappears.

Berdasarkan laporan, gosling's removal is genuinely irreversible, and the movie becomes richer because he's gone. Luke never knows the harm his decisions will cause, but every subsequent chapter bears their imprint. The twist supplies the film's underlying argument rather than simply jolting the audience. Few early revelations reshape a story so completely.

Berdasarkan laporan, the most frightening moment in hereditary arrives long before the full nature of its supernatural threat emerges. Her behavior seems central to the family's mystery. Ari Aster directs the audience's attention toward Charlie (Milly Shapiro), the withdrawn daughter of Annie Graham (Toni Collette). Then, roughly 30 minutes in, Charlie suffers an allergic reaction at a party.

Berdasarkan laporan, her brother peter (alex wolff) races toward a hospital, but charlie leans out of the car for air and is killed when her head strikes a roadside pole. Peter drives home in shock and leaves his sister's body for his mother to discover. The silence is almost unbearable.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, charlie's death doesn't merely remove a character who appeared important. It changes the film's emotional temperature. Annie's grief becomes a destructive force within the family, and Peter's guilt turns ordinary encounters into acts of psychological torture. By the time the occult elements become clearer, viewers have already been living inside an intimate domestic catastrophe.

Berdasarkan laporan, that sustained aftermath is what places hereditary above the other modern films here. The shock arrives early, but that grief poisons nearly every scene that follows. Among cinema's bleakest movies, it's particularly ruthless about making grief feel inescapable. Only Hitchcock's earlier, genre-changing act of narrative betrayal edges it out.

Berdasarkan laporan, alfred hitchcock spends nearly 45 minutes making psycho seem like janet leigh's movie. Her arrival at the Bates Motel seems like another complication for a woman who has made a terrible decision. Marion Crane steals $40,000 from her employer and flees, fearing arrest. Even her conversation with Norman Bates (Anthony Perkins) appears to belong to Marion's journey.

Berdasarkan laporan, then she steps into the shower, and the entire film changes. Hitchcock kills the apparent heroine before the halfway point, discarding the stolen-money plot along with her. Viewers who identified with Marion suddenly find themselves watching Norman clean up the crime scene. They may even catch themselves hoping he won't be caught.

Diungkapkan bahwa that was an extraordinary gamble in 1960, when leigh's star status would ordinarily have guaranteed her survival until the final act. Hitchcock even required theaters to refuse late arrivals, protecting the carefully timed experience. The shower murder is now one of cinema's most recognizable sequences, but familiarity can obscure how radically it disrupted storytelling conventions.

Berdasarkan laporan, other movies have killed prominent characters earlier. Psycho remains the standard because the revelation changes whom audiences follow and what they want to happen next. Some have delivered bloodier surprises. Its influence runs directly through Scream and The Place Beyond the Pines, yet the original still feels audacious.

Berdasarkan laporan, hitchcock doesn't wait to pull the rug out from under his viewers. He takes away the floor while they're still getting comfortable.

#592. Jensen Huang’s Scandal Explained: Alleged Affairs and Spying Claims

📅 14 Nov 2026

Jensen Huang’s Scandal Explained: Alleged Affairs and Spying Claims

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.usmagazine.com/celebrity-news/news/jensen-huangs-affair-and-spying-scandal-explained/

Nvidia cofounder Jensen Huang is at the center of a major scandal involving alleged affairs, suspected Chinese espionage and questions about his leadership.

Jensen, 63, cofounded Nvidia in 1993 and helped build the technology giant into a global tech powerhouse.

Nvidia is best known for producing the advanced computer chips that power artificial intelligence systems, making it hugely influential in the AI industry.

Jensen, who has been married to his wife, Lori Huang, since 1985, is facing scrutiny following reports about his personal relationships and a possible connection to a Chinese intelligence operation.

So, what exactly happened? Scroll on for everything to know about the Jensen Huang scandal.

Jensen admitted to cheating on his wife via a message to Nvidia employees sent on November 8.

Diungkapkan bahwa in the statement, he apologized for being “unfaithful” to lori and “letting down” his family. (The couple share two children. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, “there is no excuse for what i did. “Throughout my life, my family has given me love and support. I take full responsibility for what I did and the hurt I caused, and I accept the criticism that comes with it. Instead, I let them down and damaged the life we built together. They deserve my honesty and loyalty. I am deeply sorry,” he wrote. ”.

Jensen did not share additional details about his alleged affair or release any names of anyone involved.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, chinese businesswoman, alice huang, (no family relation to jensen huang) has been linked to jensen. She is also known as Huang Le.

Speculation around the nature of their relationship has caused huge controversy.

According to reports, Jensen developed a personal relationship with Alice, who worked as an executive at Singapore-based company Megaspeed International.

Investigators reportedly raised concerns that she may have been a “honey trap,” potentially using her relationship with Jensen to gain access to sensitive business information.

However, the espionage allegations have not been publicly proven, and there is no established evidence that Jensen knowingly passed sensitive information to China or that Alice was acting as a spy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, china has rejected the espionage allegations, dismissing them as baseless. Alice has not publicly responded to the claims.

Further allegations of more extra-marital affairs involving the tech billionaire have since emerged.

According to The New York Times, Jensen was also linked to Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of healthcare.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, reuters subsequently reported on november 12 that jensen allegedly had an intimate relationship with another woman who worked at nvidia. Her identity has not been publicly disclosed.

Reuters reported that efforts to reach the woman were unsuccessful, and Nvidia declined to comment.

Us reached out to Powell and Nvidia for further comment.

As Jensen continues to face backlash, he resigned as Nvidia CEO on November 12, after more than three decades leading the company.

“The Board and the company thank Jensen for his immeasurable contributions to the company and the industry,” Nvidia said in a news release announcing his resignation.

Chief financial officer Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO while the board attempts to find a permanent replacement.

Nvidia’s board reportedly launched an independent investigation into whether Jensen had been targeted by a foreign intelligence operation and whether any confidential company information may have been compromised.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i had somebody call me — actually the day that i was graduating — and they had spoken to my mom, and she called me [crying]. Berdasarkan laporan, “it’s beautiful because you’ll always remember every single line and every day that you had the opportunity to be that character,” he shared. “It doesn’t mean for even a second that somebody else can’t go and do something beautiful with it. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, terraciano continued: “i got the joy of playing sean, and i got to send him off into the world. We’re both getting to show what we do and then send Sean off into the world. Now somebody else gets that joy. ”.

#594. Ronald D. Moore Has Found The Perfect Outlander Replacement

📅 14 Nov 2026

Ronald D. Moore Has Found The Perfect Outlander Replacement

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://screenrant.com/god-of-war-outlander-replacement-ronald-d-moore/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for almost 12 years, ronald d. Now that the show has drawn to a conclusion, however, he’s already found a replacement for it, against a different historical backdrop. Moore’s epic romantic fantasy series Outlander has been the mainstay of his TV career. Anyone who enjoys Outlander will undoubtedly find plenty to love in this new series, which is also adapted from a major franchise in another medium.

Diungkapkan bahwa there are few more exciting upcoming fantasy shows set to debut in 2027 than moore’s next project, which features spectacular world-building and a lead actor who would have been the number one pick of many franchise fans. Most likely premiering on Prime Video at the backend of next year, it’s almost certain to take the streaming charts by storm.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if outlander is a fantasy tv series worth the commitment, then this new release fronted by dave bautista will probably move a little faster, as it tells the story of a traditional hero’s journey. God of War is being adapted from the hugely successful video game franchise of the same name, which follows a mythological hero by the name of Kratos across the ancient world.

Berdasarkan laporan, a swashbuckling warrior who’s somewhat larger in build than jamie fraser, kratos straddles ancient greek and norse mythology in his gaming iteration. However, Ronald D. Moore’s God of War will pick up his story in the Norse realm of Midgard, as he and his son Atreus attempt to climb the highest mountain in any known land.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, just as outlander ostensibly ends in tragedy for jamie and claire, a tragic event shapes the premise of prime video’s god of war. Kratos is undertaking his quest following the death of Faye, otherwise known as Laufey the Just, who is the mother of Atreus. It’s this tragedy that ultimately motivates the journey of father and son to try and reach the highest peak of the nine Norse realms.

Sebagaimana diketahui, steeped in real ancient mythology and the traditions of the fantasy genre, god of war is set up to be every bit the pseudohistorical epic that outlander has become over the past decade. There are key similarities between the two shows when it comes to family dynamics, world-building on a colossal scale using extensive source material, and a visually compelling mix of gritty realism and fantastical phenomena.

Dave Bautista has already gone through an incredible transformation to play Kratos in God of War, which proves all the critics of his casting wrong.

Berdasarkan laporan, only an adaptation of this scope could have moved ronald d. Moore to dive into another fantasy project following eight seasons of Outlander. Moore is the main developer, executive producer, and showrunner of God of War, which we can also expect to span several years, in not quite as many episodes as the story of Claire and Jamie Fraser.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, instead, the show will likely have fewer, shorter seasons, but look even larger and more cinematic onscreen. After all, there’s surely a higher visual threshold for the suspension of disbelief when depicting Norse mythology than there is for depictions of 17th century Scotland.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the confirmation that god of war has recast dave bautista as kratos following an on-set injury to the original choice for lead actor, ryan hurst, has taken expectations for the series up a notch. Bautista’s magnetic screen presence and physical attributes will help convince viewers of the series protagonist’s godlike qualities on the battlefield.

Sebagaimana diketahui, meanwhile, the likes of teresa palmer and ed skrein stand out in an impressive supporting cast, while early images of the show suggest that we’re in for a fantasy story grounded in visual naturalism, much as outlander is. God of War is shaping up to be one of the genre’s biggest new releases of the 2020s, and fans of Ronald D. Moore’s work should be counting down the days until its release.

Sauron's Nine Rings offer healing and unimaginable power, but the price is far worse than death.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the lord of the rings: the rings of power season 3 sees sauron begin to recruit the nine lieutenants that will one day become the nazgûl, or ringraiths. ” Rather than immediately enslaving their wearers, Sauron's rings heal their injuries, cure terrible afflictions, and grant them extraordinary power. Tolkien’s lore are a bit scarce when it comes to the gradual transformation of the Ringwraiths, Rings of Power initially presents the rings as miraculous gifts that transform the Men who wear them into Nazgnagôl, or "Ring-servants. While details in J. R. R. The catch is that every gift brings its recipient closer to surrendering his freedom.

For Rings of Power co-creator Patrick McKay, depicting that transformation is one of the biggest reasons to make the series in the first place.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as part of the series, mckay and his fellow showrunner j. D. Payne wanted to establish why anyone would willingly accept a ring from Sauron, the self-proclaimed Dark Lord, in the first place.

The LOTR showrunners and star reveal why now is the perfect time to feature an essential character.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "it was very important to j. and I that there was a reason you would want to wear one, which is that it would give you wealth and power," McKay says. "The idea that, in the lore, thousands of years from now, they're enslaved to Sauron's will, they've lost their humanity, and they're ghost-like wraiths, that's a long way off. D. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, "that's the bill coming. Right now, it's the good times. ".

Note: Spoilers follow for the first four episodes of Rings of Power season 3.

Sebagaimana diketahui, executive producing director charlotte brändström wanted the nazgnagôl to feel recognizably human while also possessing an unsettling supernatural presence. That begins right at the start of season 3, when a Nazgnagôl shows up in a battle between Elves and Orcs where Galadriel (Morfydd Clark) confronts the Nazgnagôl — and is handily defeated before escaping.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i slowed down everything around them," brändström says, explaining that she filmed the characters at either 36 or 48 frames per second. She also introduced echoes and reverberation into their movements and voices.

Diungkapkan bahwa the nazgnagôl's unnerving composure is just as important as their supernatural abilities. "They know the power they have. "We could feel their power by the fact that they never needed to hurry," she says. ".

Despite their terrifying appearances and abilities, Brändström emphasizes that the Nazgnagôl haven't completely transformed into the monsters audiences recognize from The Lord of the Rings.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "they still have a human side to them at that moment. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa that distinction is crucial. Tolkien's Nazgûl are terrifying precisely because they have become so thoroughly enslaved to Sauron that almost nothing remains of their former identities. The Rings of Power is exploring how that happens, beginning with men who have understandable reasons to accept the rings and gradually revealing the price of their newfound power.

Diungkapkan bahwa by the time season 3 begins, sauron has already recruited three kings of men to become nazgnagôl. Early in the premiere episode, we’re given a look at the brutal audition process when five leaders from Rhûn sent by the Dark Wizard (Ciarán Hinds) arrive in Mordor to forge an alliance between the two kingdoms. Sauron recounts how their ancestors ruled Rhûn for a thousand years before the wizard showed up and cursed their flesh and that of their descendants.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after an orc kills the two that are most loyal to the dark wizard, sauron reveals a small box holding the remaining rings of power but says he can only spare one. Then he drops a sword on the ground, implying that the last man standing can claim it. The victor is Khamûl the Easterling (Zubin Varla). After he undergoes a painful transformation, the wizard’s curse is cleansed, and Sauron dubs him “the fairest of the Nine. ” Newly empowered, Khamûl is later able to confront and overpowers the Dark Wizard to effectively seize control of Rhûn.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, khamûl is also a significant figure in tolkien's mythology. As detailed in Unfinished Tales, Khamûl is associated with the East and ranks second among the Nine. He's the only Nazgûl identified by a personal name, apart from the title of the Witch-king of Angmar. That makes his connection to Rhûn fitting, although the specific circumstances of his recruitment and his confrontation with the Dark Wizard are unique to Rings of Power.

Berdasarkan laporan, we later see the same violent ritual play out with men from the southlands, which includes theo (tyroe muhafidin). After Theo wins the contest, Sauron conducts a dark ritual that supposedly identifies his lineage: according to the Great Deceiver, Theo is descended from “a noble house of old” that were “the sworn servants of Mordor” supposedly born with special powers. Sauron rationalizes that this is why Theo was previously drawn to the sword hilt that essentially unlocked Mordor at the end of season 1. Whether or not all of this is true, Theo does accept the ring.

Berdasarkan laporan, in an interview with nerdist, muhafidin described theo's growing resentment toward arondir, whom he holds partly responsible for failing to protect bronwyn. Sauron manipulates that desperation and offers Theo great power. “I think we find him at the beginning of the season kind of void of that hope and angered by the pain the world has dealt out to him,” he said. By the time Theo really starts to question what the ring might cost him, it’s already too late.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the most devastating demonstration of the nazgnagôl's predicament comes during the climactic battle at gundabad in episode 4. After Arondir discovers the long-lost Celeborn (Jamie Campbell Bower) in a cell, they attempt to escape the Orc stronghold with Galadriel (Morfydd Clark) on the back of a Great Eagle. But then a Nazgnagôl confronts Arondir, and Theo takes off the mask.

Berdasarkan laporan, rather than immediately attack, theo urges arondir to leave. Unlike the Nazgûl, Nazgnagôl like Theo here still have their autonomy to an extent. Sauron’s influence and corruption have yet to completely take over. Arondir refuses to abandon Theo, and for a moment, it seems like he might actually take the ring off. Then Sauron arrives and forces Theo to kill Arondir as if he’s already exerting total control.

Diungkapkan bahwa arondir's death is doubly heartbreaking because theo recognizes the man standing before him. But whatever humanity remains inside him isn't enough to prevent the Dark Lord from asserting control. We all remember the Nazgûl as these terrifying, faceless, and inhumane wraiths. Are the Nazgnagôl more or less frightening when we can still see the people beneath the mask long before they’re totally destroyed?.

Not only that, but the viewers learn that she is not very different from him and has a body count of her own, including Joe’s neighbor Delilah (Carmela Zumbado) and his ex, Candace (Ambyr Childers).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, by season 3, love transforms into a full-blown antagonist alongside joe as her killing streak continues. Pedretti nails the sudden switches. Pedretti’s run on the show lasted for just two seasons but turned her into one of the most talked-about characters in the entire series. Love can be a devoted mother and a woman quietly measuring out a paralyzing dose of aconite in the same breath. What makes Love so compelling as a character, though, is that she's the only “You” who ever turns Joe's logic back on him to show him the mirror. Fans still debate whether any of Joe’s other love interests ever matched up to Love because her absence was felt in every season that followed.

Diungkapkan bahwa noah hawley's fargo has introduced plenty of strange criminals across its anthology seasons, but none have lived up to lorne malvo’s (billy bob thornton) legacy. The antagonist is a drifter-for-hire who rolls into Bemidji, Minnesota, and meets insurance salesman Lester Nygaard (Martin Freeman) in a hospital waiting room. Then, almost on a whim, Malvo offers to kill the bully who has tormented Lester since high school. That one conversation sets off a chain of murders that pulls in Deputy Molly Solverson (Allison Tolman) and Duluth cop Gus Grimly (Colin Hanks), while Malvo glides through Season 1 and leaves a trail of bodies and terrified witnesses behind him.

Sebagaimana diketahui, malvo isn't a serial killer in the textbook sense. He kills simply because he can, and treats every encounter as a way to instigate the people around him. Malvo is a force of nature in the show because the audience never truly learns who he is. There's no ritual or compulsion behind his murders, and that's exactly what makes him so frightening. They only know what he does, and the mystery around the villain turns into his greatest strength.

Berdasarkan laporan, killing eve turned the cat-and-mouse thriller into a flirtation, and villanelle (jodie comer) is the reason the approach worked. She travels across Europe to carry out elaborate hits in increasingly outrageous outfits, and in the very first episode, she kills a man at a Tuscan villa with a hairpin to the eye. Villanelle is a Russian-born assassin who works for a shadowy organization called The Twelve. Her handler, Konstantin (Kim Bodnia), does his best to keep her under control, but that becomes nearly impossible once Villanelle fixates on MI5 officer Eve Polastri (Sandra Oh), the woman assigned to track her down.

Berdasarkan laporan, what’s more fascinating is that eve becomes just as obsessed with villanelle in return. Comer, who won an Emmy for the role in 2019, delivers one of the most playful performances of her career as Villanelle. She kills with a carefreeness that makes murder feel like a cure for her boredom. However, as the seasons go on, the audience also understands her vulnerability and the need to be seen. Villanelle proved a villain could be charming and terrifying in the very same scene and has set the benchmark for female antagonists for years to come.

Sebagaimana diketahui, turning psycho into a modern-day prequel sounded like a terrible idea on paper, but bates motel became one of a&e's best dramas, and freddie highmore’s brilliant take on the iconic norman bates has a lot to do with that. Highmore plays the teenage version of the character from Hitchcock’s film, who moves with his mother, Norma (Vera Farmiga), to the coastal town of White Pine Bay, Oregon, after the sudden death of his father. There, Norma buys the motel that would become infamous, and over five seasons, the series traces Norman's slow transformation from an awkward, sweet kid into the messy antagonist that he was always destined to be.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as the story progresses, "mother" takes up more and more space in his head. The show essentially makes the audience watch Norman fight a losing battle. Highmore never plays Norman as a monster, but as a boy who desperately wants to be good, in spite of his dark side. They already know what is going to happen when Marion Crane (Rihanna) finally enters the picture, but the build-up to that point is what makes the show such an engaging watch. The final season's reworking of Psycho's infamous shower scene and Norman’s fate is a bold swing, but Bates Motel manages to pull it off thanks to how carefully it shaped Norman’s character instead of just portraying him as a horror icon.

Diungkapkan bahwa the fall makes an unusual choice by telling the audience who the killer is in the very first episode. The series follows bereavement counselor and married father of two, Paul Spector (Jamie Dornan), who maintains the facade of being a family man while he stalks young professional women by night. The story picks up when Detective Superintendent Stella Gibson (Gillian Anderson) is brought in from London to review the unsolved murder of a young woman in Belfast, and she soon realizes that she is hunting a serial killer who just so happens to be Paul. Soon enough, her hunt for Spector becomes a game of cat and mouse, with the audience always knowing what both sides are planning.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the real thrill lies in watching the two of them inch closer to each other and watching paul’s carefully crafted lies slowly fall apart. The Fall removes the whodunit element from the thriller genre and forces the audience to face how easy it is for Paul to fool everyone around him. He is a chilling villain because of how ordinary he seems, since there is no tragic backstory or supernatural force behind all his violence. Dornan plays the character with remarkable restraint, which makes him all the more disturbing and reminds the audience that the most dangerous killers are often the ones nobody would suspect.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, four criminal masterminds. One of them was always going to be yours. Here is who comes for you, why they picked you out of everyone available, and what they want from the encounter.

Diungkapkan bahwa your nemesis does not want to beat you. He wants to know you completely, and he is patient enough to wait for it. The frightening part is how good the conversation is.

Diungkapkan bahwa your nemesis is not after money, territory or revenge. He is after a demonstration, and you are the person he has chosen to prove his point on.

Diungkapkan bahwa your nemesis respects you, which sounds flattering until you work out what it means. He chose you because nobody else was worth his time.

Sebagaimana diketahui, your nemesis has no personal interest in you whatsoever, and that is precisely what makes him unsurvivable. You are not a rival. You are a stop on the way.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mindhunter is built around conversations, and none of them are as chilling as the ones with edmund kemper (cameron britton). The villain, based on the real-life Co-Ed Killer, is serving life in a California prison when FBI agents Holden Ford (Jonathan Groff) and Bill Tench (Holt McCallany) visit him as part of their early research into what would become modern criminal profiling. Kemper stands at six-foot-nine and is far sharper than either agent expects. He is also a little too happy to talk, and he walks them through his crimes in calm, matter-of-fact detail.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, britton earned an emmy nomination for the role, and it's easy to see why. Then, in that same easygoing way, he randomly describes the horrific ways in which he has killed people, and the audience is brought back to reality. In the game-changing Mindhunter, he plays Kemper as polite and articulate, ready to help Holden and Bill in a way that almost makes him feel normal. Kemper only appears in a handful of episodes in the brilliant show, but it’s remarkable how Britton’s performances did so much with so little screen time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, joe goldberg (penn badgley) had to be on this list, because no other antagonist has come close to his level of creepiness. The character is a New York bookstore manager who falls for aspiring writer Guinevere Beck (Elizabeth Lail) the moment he sets eyes on her. That’s not the beginning of a romantic story, though, because it doesn’t take long for the audience to realize how obsessive and manipulative Joe really is. Over five seasons, his obsessions take him from New York to Los Angeles and eventually London. Anyone he believes stands between him and the woman of the moment ends up dead, and this completely reckless way of taking people’s lives is what makes Joe so scary.

Sebagaimana diketahui, on the surface, he appears to be the perfect lover boy who is willing to do anything for the woman he loves, but what he really wants is control. What makes the show work is Joe’s voiceover, which lets the audience hear every self-serving justification he tells himself. He genuinely believes he is the hero of every story, and the show is clever enough to make viewers almost agree with him before reminding them exactly who he is. This uncomfortable closeness to his thoughts is what keeps Joe more unsettling than nearly any other killer on TV.

Diungkapkan bahwa the question of who killed laura palmer (sheryl lee) turned twin peaks into a cultural event in 1990, and the answer remains one of the most devastating reveals in tv history. In the episode "Lonely Souls," Leland's reflection reveals BOB's face as he attacks Laura's cousin, Maddy Ferguson, also played by Lee, while Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) is still piecing the case together across town. Midway through Season 2, the show confirms that Laura's killer is her own father, Leland Palmer (Ray Wise), possessed by the demonic entity known as BOB (Frank Silva). Ray Wise is unforgettable in the role, especially since the show never fully explains whether Leland was BOB’s victim or something worse, and that mystery is a big part of why he still haunts viewers today.

Sebagaimana diketahui, david lynch and mark frost used bob to tell a story about abuse that tv in the '90s wasn’t ready to talk about openly. Leland is more than a typical antagonist because Twin Peaks lets viewers grieve with him first. Even his final scene, where a freed Leland breaks down in Cooper’s arms as he remembers what he did, refuses to let viewers fully hate him. He is the father sobbing at Laura’s funeral and singing show tunes in the hotel lobby, so the reveal feels like a betrayal of the audience as much as of his family. His impact also goes far beyond the show itself, since countless TV mysteries since then have tried to recreate the same sense of dread and shock that came with finally learning who killed Laura Palmer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, plenty of actors have played hannibal lecter, but mads mikkelsen made the character entirely his own in bryan fuller's hannibal. Of course, no one knows that Hannibal is the very killer the FBI is chasing. The titular character, who holds the reputation of a brilliant psychiatrist, is brought in by FBI Agent Jack Crawford (Laurence Fishburne) to keep watch over criminal profiler Will Graham (Hugh Dancy), whose ability to empathize with killers is slowly ruining him. Over three seasons, the psychiatrist organizes lavish dinner parties for the agents as he toys with Will's mind and, eventually, his heart.

Sebagaimana diketahui, no show on this list looks like hannibal. Mikkelsen plays Hannibal with an unusual finesse and rarely raises his voice, but his fascination with Will is the emotional anchor of the show. Food stylist Janice Poon made every dish gorgeous, and knowing what's actually on the plate turns every dinner scene into an absurd comedy. It’s a shame that NBC canceled the series after three seasons, just as it hit its peak, because Mikkelsen’s Hannibal was pure nightmare fuel.

Diungkapkan bahwa before dexter, a serial killer as the hero of a tv series seemed like an impossible sell. Then Michael C. Hall arrived on Showtime in 2006 as Dexter Morgan, a blood spatter analyst for Miami Metro Police by day and a killer by night. Over eight seasons, he balances that double life with his family and his foul-mouthed detective sister, Debra (Jennifer Carpenter). Dexter follows the Code of Harry, a set of rules his adoptive father, Harry (James Remar), taught him to aim his "Dark Passenger" at murderers who slipped through the system. He also faces a string of formidable rivals, including John Lithgow's Trinity Killer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, hannibal may be the better-crafted show, but no tv serial killer has shaped the genre the way dexter has. The longer the show runs, the clearer it becomes that the Code is just an excuse, and that tension between the monster and the man trying to pass as normal is what keeps Dexter so compelling. Hall’s deadpan voiceover does the rest by turning Dexter’s emptiness into dark comedy. His Code gave viewers a way to justify cheering for him, since every victim seemed to deserve it, at least at first. He allowed the audience to root for a murderer, and that alone changed what TV antiheroes could be. Nearly every killer on this list owes something to him, which is exactly why he takes the top spot.

Diungkapkan bahwa “i don’t want the story to be that litigation led to this result. Litigation is supposed to prevent these results by having people litigate in court and not have that spill into the streets,” Braithwaite said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, d. C. ’s Metropolitan Police Department first alerted the public on social media that there was an active shooter in the area of 15th Street and P Street in Logan Circle on Thursday morning. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a fire alarm was pulled to get people out of the building. “Everyone evacuated eventually pretty quickly and then we’re outside the entrance of the Vida Fitness, and police officers start coming to run inside and then another police officer is outside the entrance asking ‘What’s the description of this guy?’” Mirones said.

Berdasarkan laporan, before the shooting, lambert had built a career in emergency medicine and had more recently pivoted to work as a healthcare consultant. C. Public records and his attorney’s account paint a picture of a man with multiple properties and significant resources who had grown fixated on a single legal fight over his D. home.

They also delivered a perfectly timed anti-work masterpiece at exactly the right time, tapping into the cultural zeitgeist with a perfect season of television that still hasn't been surpassed (even by the show's own very good second season).

Sebagaimana diketahui, while both seasons of severance are phenomenal, it’s hard to describe how expertly erickson’s first nine-episode season conveys the despair of the “work-first” attitude prevalent in modern society. Erickson, who worked in a literal door factory while writing early versions of the series, takes that attitude to its most literal extreme: imagining a dystopian future where companies surgically split their employees' consciousness to create an "innie" who knows only work and an "outie" who has no idea what their own job entails.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the series opens with helly (britt lower) waking up on a table in one of the company’s main offices. Waking up at work already sounds disastrous, but like Helly, audiences learn from the disembodied voice of fellow innie Mark Scout (Adam Scott) in real time what being a Lumon employee means for her: a lifetime of all work and very little play. Naturally, Helly does not vibe with the new life her outie has chosen for her and does everything in her power to escape.

Berdasarkan laporan, the line between personal and work has grown increasingly blurred over the years, further exacerbated by the covid-19 pandemic, which forced us to reckon in real time with how little consideration is given to workers and their lives, as long as the numbers go up. This way of thinking drives Helly to be fundamentally opposed to anything and everything her bosses at Lumon try to get her to do.

Diungkapkan bahwa yet every time helly rages against the machine, she remains trapped in the system. Each time she tries to escape, she is forced back into that sad, narrow corridor. Her outie wants her to be there, creating a truly odd juxtaposition where, despite sharing the same body, Helly is wrangling with her own psyche for control. It’s a little like arguing with yourself over whether you should get takeout, only with much more dire circumstances.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, though there is a level of attraction to such a literal divide of work and pleasure — mark uses the severance program to avoid the grief of the death of his wife years before — it comes at a great cost. In an attempt to create a healthy work-life balance, Lumon and those who choose to be severed have instead condemned their inner selves to lives devoted to work, pursuing goals they neither understand nor chose.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this leaves us with several compelling questions that the nine episodes of severance’s first season try to answer. Who is real? Is it our outer selves who agreed to take on this severance procedure, or is it the innie that’s been condemned to a life of toil? Is there really a true divide?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, through helly’s acts of insurrection, she stirs something in her fellow innies that those in charge at lumon (all of whom, notably, are not severed) can’t fully suppress. Even before Helly, innies like Mark, Irving (John Turturro), and Dylan (Zach Cherry) had a vague interest in their outer selves. By the time Helly starts pointing out the imbalance between their lives, rebellion (big and small) is all but inevitable.

Diungkapkan bahwa severance season 1 unfolds as a maze of shifting identities, false starts, red herrings, and untrustworthy narrators, with each episode leaving you feeling as though your emotions have been tossed into a blender. The series is disorienting by design, constantly keeping you guessing about what’s real and whom you can trust, all while building to a mind-blowing cliffhanger finale.

Diungkapkan bahwa severance’s second season is just as tantalizing as the first, but feels less cohesive overall, spending more time with the outies and lumon’s inner workings. Although those elements are compelling, some storylines introduced in season one — like Burt and Irving’s strange but sweet relationship — fizzle out in an unsatisfying way. Season 2 is still very good, with some high highs and few lows, but it doesn’t hold a candle to the masterpiece that was Severance season 1.

However, that timeline could very well shift, especially after recent comments from the author that might result in a delay. Namely, Dinniman has confirmed that he's breaking a series tradition with the next release, and it could ultimately prove more time-consuming given the attention to detail and wrapping up of loose ends.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a recent interview with collider, matt dinniman gave readers a peek into his thought process while working on book 9, which he called "the most difficult thing i've ever written. " In the previous eight books, Dinniman has been able to stick to a somewhat self-contained (albeit often chaotic) story arc and structure.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in other words, every book has "its own self-contained storyline" that covers either one or two floors, such as the iron tangle in book 3 or the bubbles in book 5, with details about the metanarrative (e. g. , what's happening outside the World Dungeon) peppered throughout each book.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dinniman also pointed out that he's made a habit of introducing details or tidbits that he doesn't necessarily know where they're headed yet, and has been able to kick the can down the road on the various chekov's guns in the past. However, Dinniman states in the interview that he understands that's not really going to work anymore:.

Berdasarkan laporan, "[books 9 and 10 are] going to be one large arc, and then where i split it will be important and will, like, resolve something. It's clearly going to be a part one and part two. I have lots of little storylines that I'm kind of like, 'I'll deal with that in the next book,' and I can't do that anymore. I have so many little spinning plates that need to be taken care of before we can finish the story, and I have to be careful not to add new ones, which I keep doing anyway because that's just the way I write. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, essentially, it sounds like readers are in for a massive cliffhanger when it comes to book 9, given the fact it will be dependent on book 10. While it's already been confirmed that the final two books will not be released together, we don't have a good sense of just how much of a gap between the two we're looking at just yet. Based on Dinniman's publishing history, it's unlikely Book 10 will take much longer beyond Book 9, though looking at his recent comments on the difficulties with wrapping up the story, it could go either way.

Berdasarkan laporan, ultimately, patience is going to pay off when it comes to dungeon crawler carl's final chapters, and compared to some of the other big-name fantasy authors out there, the fanbase has been a bit spoiled. R. To put it in perspective, Dinniman released over 5,000 pages of story in a matter of just six years, leaving authors like George R. Martin and Rebecca Yarros in the dust, while he has already nearly matched Brandon Sanderson's entire five-book Stormlight Archive in page count in less than half the time.

#619. How Did Investigators Find Baby Who Survived Being Buried Alive? What to Know

How Did Investigators Find Baby Who Survived Being Buried Alive? What to Know

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.usmagazine.com/crime-news/news/how-south-carolina-baby-was-found-after-being-buried-alive/

The astonishing rescue of an 11-month-old baby who spent roughly 24 hours underground inside a dog crate has gripped a community in South Carolina and drawn national attention to a case authorities are calling miraculous.

Koah Sharp was pulled from the dirt alive on November 10, 2026, after his father allegedly took him from a relative’s care and buried him in the woods near Batesburg-Leesville.

Us breaks down what is known about how investigators located the boy, the charges against his father and the small details that may have saved Koah’s life.

A search party combing the area around the home of the suspect’s father noticed a patch of “freshly disturbed” dirt on the afternoon of November 10, 2026, according to Lexington County Sheriff Jay Koon.

Berdasarkan laporan, investigators began digging and soon heard the baby crying from beneath the soil, a sound koon described at a news conference as “the most joyful sound. ”.

Koah was found inside what Koon called a dog crate wrapped in a towel, and authorities believe that towel, combined with colder temperatures, likely created an air pocket that allowed him to survive.

Berdasarkan laporan, “so as you imagine, the race was on. Everybody’s getting down there trying to get him out,” Koon said.

The sheriff said Koah was “screaming at the top of his lungs” when rescuers reached him.

Berdasarkan laporan, he was rushed to a hospital and released that same evening, according to the lexington county sheriff’s department, which announced in a november 11 news release that “koah sharp is alive and well. ”.

Michael Comer, Koah’s father, was arrested and now faces charges of attempted murder, unlawful conduct toward a child, custodial interference and burglary, according to the Lexington County Sheriff’s Department.

Berdasarkan laporan, he was initially taken into custody on a burglary charge on the evening of november 9, 2026, after being located at an outbuilding in batesburg without the baby. He was denied bond on November 12.

Tyler Douglas, the lead investigator with the Lexington County Sheriff’s Department, told a judge that Comer showed no remorse for the attempted murder of his son, according to reporting from the Associated Press and CBS News.

Berdasarkan laporan, last month, comer pleaded guilty to a domestic violence charge and was sentenced to probation, per the associated press. He has reportedly not yet been appointed legal counsel.

Koah was in the care of his paternal grandmother on November 9, 2026, when Comer arrived at her home.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “she left koah with comer to run an errand while another caregiver was coming over,” koon said in a statement. “When the caregiver got there, Comer was gone and Koah was with him. ”.

A desperate search was launched across the area around Batesburg-Leesville, with the sheriff’s office posting on Facebook a description of a blue-eyed “bright boy” with reddish blond hair who regularly uses a pacifier.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, patricia comer, michael’s mother and koah’s grandmother, told nbc news that her son is “where he needs to be” following his arrest. “Honestly, I’m his mother, and I never expected this from him,” she told the outlet.

Berdasarkan laporan, john comer, the suspect’s father and koah’s grandfather, told the associated press that he witnessed his grandson being pulled from the ground on the property near his home. He said the baby was crying and covered in dirt when rescuers lifted him out.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i became ecstatic, my hands straight in the air. I’m looking in the sky, jumping up and down, praising God,” John said. “And at the same time I hit my knees and I’m just crying. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, koah was released from the hospital the evening of his rescue, and koon said he “hopefully will make a full recovery. ” The sheriff’s office initially spelled the boy’s last name as Sharpe before updating it to Sharp in subsequent releases. Comer remains in custody after being denied bond, and information about his legal representation was not immediately available at the time of the sheriff’s department’s announcements.

Investigators have continued to emphasize the narrow margin by which the baby was found alive, pointing to the towel-wrapped crate and the cooler weather as the likely reasons an air pocket formed beneath the dirt.
