#621. 20 Years Ago, the Best Sci-Fi Show of the Century Delivered the Most Epic Space Battle in TV History

📅 14 Nov 2026

20 Years Ago, the Best Sci-Fi Show of the Century Delivered the Most Epic Space Battle in TV History

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/battlestar-galactica-season-3-exodus-20-year-anniversary-adama-maneuver/

The Adama Maneuver wasn’t even the most spectacular part of Battlestar Galactica’s greatest space battle.

Berdasarkan laporan, to liberate the humans trapped under cylon occupation, admiral william adama (edward james olmos) jumps the titular battlestar galactica directly into the atmosphere of new caprica. The warship plummets toward the settlement and deploys Viper fighter jets amidst the chaos before jumping back into space moments before it would have crashed, likely obliterating the planet on impact.

Berdasarkan laporan, two decades later, this spectacle from battlestar galactica season 3’s “exodus, part 2” remains unforgettable sci-fi tv. It’s dazzling and horrifying, and still one of the coolest things ever broadcast on science-fiction television. From a tactical standpoint, the “Adama Maneuver” is absolutely bonkers and one of the riskiest spaceship tactics, perhaps ever (sorry, Vice-Admiral Holdo). What if the ship had gotten torn apart from ripping through the atmosphere? What if the FTL drive malfunctioned or didn’t activate in time? Somehow, it’s also not even the most visually impressive sequence in the episode.

Sebagaimana diketahui, minutes later, while the galactica is damaged and surrounded by enemy ships, lee adama (jamie bamber) arrives aboard the pegasus. Pegasus tears through one Cylon basestar, explodes, and sends a flaming flight pod spinning into another. He buys his father enough time to escape, evacuates his own crew, and transforms the most advanced remaining warship in humanity's fleet into an enormous battering ram. It’s both a spectacular death scene and the decisive blow in the battle to liberate New Caprica.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in one extended sequence, “exodus, part 2” ends the most frustrating period in battlestar galactica’s story, reunites its scattered cast, and restores the series’ core premise: one battered battlestar protecting the remnants of humanity as they search for earth. No one is able to recover from the trauma that easily, perhaps least of all the visual-effects artists who were forced to destroy the Pegasus.

'Pegasus' transforms what looks like a miracle into a total nightmare.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “exodus” was initially conceived as a single episode, written by bradley thompson and david weddle and directed by félix enríquez alcalá. And most of that happened in the first part of “Exodus. Against the backdrop of this militarized occupation, there was also the resistance’s ongoing ground operations, Sharon Agathon’s (Grace Park) infiltration of the Cylon compound, Kara Thrace’s (Katee Sackhoff) imprisonment by Leoben Conoy (Callum Keith Rennie), and Ellen Tigh’s (Kate Vernon) betrayal, which led to her being poisoned before her execution. But the rescue of New Caprica eventually became too large for one hour. ” There was simply too much story happening — and honestly too much to fully recap here.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, according to moore, who talked about the production on a series of podcast episodes released alongside the show, splitting “exodus” into two episodes also helped the production absorb the considerable cost of the new caprica storyline. The opening of season 3 required new sets, location shooting, large numbers of extras, and significantly more visual effects than an ordinary episode. By turning the material into a two-parter — episodes 3 and 4 in the overall season — the producers were able to stretch that expensive infrastructure across another hour of television.

Diungkapkan bahwa that history helps explain the rhythm of “exodus. ” Part 1 is full of tension as it essentially tightens the spring. Samuel Anders (Michael Trucco) discovers that Ellen betrayed the resistance to save her husband, Saul Tigh (Michael Hogan). Adama orders Lee to protect the civilian fleet and continue the search for Earth if Galactica doesn’t return within 18 hours. The resistance prepares for its uprising. Sharon retrieves the launch keys for the civilian ships. Then Part 2 releases all that tension almost all at once.

Diungkapkan bahwa saul poisons ellen rather than surrender her to the resistance for execution. The uprising begins. Laura Roslin (Mary McDonnell) retakes Colonial One. Anders rescues Kara from Leoben’s apartment. The civilian ships begin to launch. That’s when Galactica falls out of the sky.

Sebagaimana diketahui, during his podcast commentary, moore watched the sequence and remarked that the episode had better win the emmy for visual effects. “Exodus, Part 2” won the 2007 Emmy for Outstanding Special Visual Effects for a Series, along with the Visual Effects Society award for Outstanding Visual Effects in a Broadcast Series. Less than a year later, it did. The episode also received Emmy nominations for its direction and sound editing. But the episode still had a larger spectacle in reserve.

Berdasarkan laporan, once galactica jumps out of new caprica’s atmosphere, adama discovers that four cylon basestars are waiting for him. Already damaged by the free fall, the ship has little chance of survival. As he often does when facing certain death, Adama quietly tells his crew that it has been an honor to serve with them.

Sebagaimana diketahui, except lee disobeys a direct order and jumps the pegasus in to assist. Lee orders the crew to abandon ship, sets its weapons to fire automatically, and pauses on the empty bridge to offer his command one final “Thank you. Pegasus immediately destroys one basestar and draws enough fire to allow Galactica to escape. ” Then he and the dwindling crew set it on a direct collision course with the enemy ships.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, destroying pegasus had always been part of the general plan for the new caprica storyline, even if the writers changed the circumstances across various drafts. At one point, the creative team considered destroying Galactica instead and moving the military crew onto the newer, better Pegasus. But that would have meant abandoning the title of the series.

Diungkapkan bahwa the pegasus sets occupied valuable studio space, and maintaining two capital ships forced the production to divide its personnel and background performers between separate locations. The creative team also wanted to build new Cylon basestar interiors for the stories that followed. There just wasn’t enough room to do it all.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the visual-effects team nevertheless became attached to the ship. When its artists learned that Pegasus was scheduled for destruction, they hung a large “SAVE THE PEGASUS” banner outside their workspace, directly across from Moore’s office. “It was very funny and it was really endearing,” Moore said, “but we destroyed the Pegasus anyway — so goodbye, Peggy. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa the ship’s destruction became an enormous undertaking for atmosphere visual effects. Because its ships, explosions, weapons fire, and debris interacted so extensively, much of the work couldn’t be simplified through pre-compositing. Lead compositor Brenda Campbell later recalled that the climactic sequence contained roughly 250 to 300 elements in each compositing flow, spread across approximately 10 shots. Campbell had about a week and a half to finish it.

Diungkapkan bahwa the scale extended into the background. Some battle shots featured hundreds of individually animated Cylon Raiders that hadn’t even appeared in the original previsualization. The artists then added camera movement, flares, and the unusually heavy layer of grain that helped Battlestar Galactica’s digital effects match the show’s handheld, documentary-inspired photography.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the collision destroys the first basestar outright. Then one of Pegasus’ burning flight pods breaks away, careens through the battle, and strikes another. Humanity may have lost the Pegasus, but at least it took out three Cylon basestars in the process.

Berdasarkan laporan, in a way, “exodus” delivers a satisfying reset to the show’s original structure. But its characters return to that version of normalcy carrying more trauma than ever before. After spending four episodes grounded on New Caprica, Battlestar Galactica resumes its familiar “scrappy military ship on the run” format. The occupation is over, but the damage it caused has barely begun to reveal itself.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that’s what separates “exodus” from an impressive hour of action television. It delivers the enormous catharsis its story demands, but it never pretends that liberation alone is a simple fix for anything. The heroes escape, but they cannot return to who they were before New Caprica. Neither can the fleet: Humanity is free again, but it has sacrificed its most powerful warship to get there.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, twenty years later, it’s easy to understand why the visual-effects artists wanted to save “peggy” — and why the writers knew they couldn’t. The Adama Maneuver may be the image everyone remembers, but the destruction of Pegasus gives “Exodus” its emotional climax. If the artists couldn’t save their favorite ship, they could at least give it a death spectacular enough to ensure nobody would ever forget it.

#628. Zelda Fans Who Loved Ocarina of Time Need to Play This Game Next

📅 14 Nov 2026

Zelda Fans Who Loved Ocarina of Time Need to Play This Game Next

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/zelda-link-past-retrospective-35-years/

Diungkapkan bahwa by now, you’ve probably had time to play the legend of zelda: ocarina of time remake on the nintendo switch 2. You’ve marveled at what a great job it does of bringing the classic Nintendo 64 adventure to a new generation, with visual improvements and quality-of-life changes to make it more palatable for that new audience. Maybe you’ve even run through it a second time.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as good as ocarina of time might be, however, it’s just one game. It can’t keep you busy forever. And assuming you’re not tired of Hyrule and Zelda just yet, there’s one game you definitely should consider for your next conquest. Once you’re finished with that grand adventure, you’ll need to decide what to play next. That game is The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, and it did a brilliant job of introducing key elements that players loved about Ocarina of Time several years later, including an intricate world that changes over the course of the epic adventure.

Berdasarkan laporan, incredible as it may seem, the legend of zelda: a link to the past is already 35 years old. How can so much time have passed already? I have vivid memories of terrific games I played before Link’s first Super Nintendo outing ever occurred. 21, 1991. It arrived in Japan on Nov. Time clearly flies as fast for some of us, every bit as readily as it did for Link in Ocarina of Time.

Diungkapkan bahwa when a link to the past hit japan in 1991 and then launched in north america five months later, it provided the most meaningful update the zelda series would see for decades. Both of them were wildly different. Up to that point, there were only two console releases. A Link to the Past cemented what a Zelda game should be, offering its grandest open world yet, stuffed with thrilling dungeons built on a foundation of everything that came before them.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the game began with link following his uncle out into the rain in search of the imprisoned princess zelda. As his quest neared its apparent conclusion, Link learned that it had really only just begun. He freed her and then began a search for three magical pendants, the better to someday vanquish an evil wizard. He soon found himself traveling frequently between two realms: the Light World and the Dark World.

Diungkapkan bahwa the dark world is a link to the past’s grandest innovation. A lake became a glacier, and a thriving village turned into a hideout for bandits. Sand dunes turned to fetid swamp. They might have thought they knew everything. Players spent hours exploring every corner of Hyrule, from the warm desert sands in the southwest to the cascading waterfalls and mountains in the north. Then another dimension came along and turned all of that on its head. Truly, the alternate realm lived up to its title.

Berdasarkan laporan, but the dark world offered more than just a dreary aesthetic. Actions Link took in one realm allowed him to make progress in the other, in ways large and small. Players got to know the landscape more intimately than ever before, or else they could never reach some of the places where their greatest adventures waited. A Heart Piece might rest on a ledge that lay out of reach. A trip between dimensions added a walkway that finally granted access. Or a dungeon entrance might lie out of reach, but a trip between worlds would reveal a new path. In the end, Link’s ingenuity and bravery provided the strength necessary to defeat a familiar foe: Ganon.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ocarina of time built on much of that same design, with just enough differences to make it all feel fresh. Three dungeons later, circumstances force them apart. Link wakes to find an insistent fairy by his side, instead of having his dreams disturbed by a telepathic plea. Instead of traveling to another realm, the lad simply wakes in a different time period. He meets Zelda early in his adventure. It is a dark one, every bit as disastrous as the Dark World in the previous game.

Diungkapkan bahwa a weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you’ve just finished exploring that structure in ocarina of time, the time is right to experience the super nintendo version that pioneered its best attributes. For people who enjoy the evolution of a medium, there’s true joy in exploring those roots, even now. It should serve as a reminder that the best entertainment experiences of today don’t come from nowhere. You’ll be able to better appreciate just how much impact a classic 2D game had on the series as it evolved into 3D. They often represent an evolution of everything that came before them. And few games deserve your attention as much as A Link to the Past.

Zelda's ability to endure over decades is a miracle.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, whether we're talking about a miniseries like garth marenghi's darkplace or a full-length show like arcane, these remarkable shows proved beyond a shadow of a doubt that sci-fi doesn't need to run for decades in order to be incredible. For the purposes of this list, only shows that have already delivered their series finale will be counted, seeing as there are some other sci-fi masterpieces which are less than 20 episodes long only because they're still ongoing.

Diungkapkan bahwa it was with wandavision that the mcu made its first true, fully interconnected foray onto the small screen. To this day, however, the highest-rated MCU show from Disney+ on IMDb is Loki, and that's for good reason. We're talking about one of the most perfect superhero shows of the last five years, focused on one of the most universally beloved MCU characters out there.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a solo loki project was long overdue, and fans couldn't have possibly asked for a better final result. With only two seasons and 12 episodes in total, the show delivered some incredible visuals and production values, a delectable high-concept premise that all fans of multiversal sci-fi should love, and a surprisingly emotional climax for Loki's years-long character arc.

Diungkapkan bahwa pitched by creators josé rivera and karl schaefer as a sort of "twin peaks for kids," eerie, indiana is one of the strangest, most fascinatingly surreal children's series in the history of television. It's an absolute tragedy that low ratings and high production costs led NBC to cancel it after only one season and 19 episodes in total, because it really did have the potential to grow into something even better.

Diungkapkan bahwa nonetheless, eerie, indiana has remained one of the biggest cult classic shows of its era as the years since its untimely cancellation have passed, with fans hailing it as one of the few true sci-fi show masterpieces of the '90s. Strongly reminiscent of future classics like Gravity Falls and Stranger Things, it's an exquisitely weird, creative, and at times downright scary little gem of children's television.

Sebagaimana diketahui, screenwriters matthew graham and ashley pharoah originally came up with the idea that would eventually turn into life on mars back in 1998, envisioning a time travel series satirizing '70s society. At the time, broadcasters rejected the concept. It wouldn't be until 2006 that the show would finally see the light of day, and today, many remember it as one of those mystery shows that are perfect from start to finish.

Berdasarkan laporan, blending elements of the police procedural, supernatural drama, and sci-fi historical drama genres, life on mars is one of the greatest british genre shows of the 21st century. With its 16 episodes across a two-season run, it delivered a mind-bending existential mystery that doesn't lose any of its magic even after several revisits. It's creative, it's emotionally moving, and it's philosophically sharp.

Sebagaimana diketahui, seeing as alan moore and dave gibbons' watchmen is universally recognized as one of the most important and influential works of art in the history of comic books, it's unsurprising that the announcement of an hbo television sequel created by lost's damon lindelof had fans feeling skeptical. In the end, divisive though it was (and remains), it would by no means be exaggerated to say that Lindelof's Watchmen went so far as to surpass those expectations.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one of the most thoroughly perfect must-watch miniseries of the last decade, a nine-episode masterpiece pitched by lindelof as a sort of remix of the original comic series. The show takes the source material's uniquely punchy thematic and philosophical core and masterfully turns it into a sharply 21st-century tale, scathingly talking about themes like systemic racism and historical trauma.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the channel 4 british conspiracy thriller series utopia is one of the greatest cult classics of 2010s television, one of those sci-fi shows with absolutely no filler episodes. Over the course of two seasons and 12 episodes in total, the show delivered a masterfully dark and complex study of themes of deep-state paranoia and utilitarian morality.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, due to its extremely graphic violence and the way it holds back no punches in depicting sensitive topics like school shootings and political assassinations, the show was hugely polarizing and controversial back when it was on air. Though low ratings led Channel 4 to cancel the series, it has remained a taboo-breaking cult classic in the years since, a must-see for people who love transgressive science fiction.

Sebagaimana diketahui, based on their stage show garth marenghi's fright knight, richard ayoade and matthew holness created the channel 4 miniseries garth marenghi's darkplace. Delightfully meta in every way imaginable, this cult classic is both a loving tribute to cheap '80s sci-fi and horror shows and a parody of the pretentious "auteurs" who created them.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with an irresistible sense of humor and a cast at the top of their comedic game, garth marenghi's darkplace is one of those miniseries that are absolutely perfect masterpieces, and six episodes were all it took for it to achieve that status. It's campy, it's absurd, it's deceivingly intelligent, and it's endlessly rewatchable in a uniquely (and very intentional) so-bad-it's-good way.

Diungkapkan bahwa fans have been clamoring for a second season of the unfairly-canceled scavengers reign for years, and creators joe bennett and charles huettner have admitted that there certainly are some ideas for a potential revival. Nonetheless, the series was originally pitched as a perfectly self-contained miniseries; and as such, it's an airtight sci-fi story with a perfectly satisfying conclusion, which all those who love the genre should watch at least once.

Diungkapkan bahwa people who think that animation is somehow lesser than live-action science fiction have clearly not watched scavengers reign, one of the best adult animated shows where every episode's a masterpiece. Highly experimental and avant-garde in its approach throughout 12 episodes, it's far more focused on complex character development and incredibly intricate world-building than it is on any traditional sense of plot.

Berdasarkan laporan, as if any more proof were needed that animated science fiction deserves every bit as much respect as live-action science fiction, there's also arcane, netflix's adaptation of the legendary multiplayer online battle arena game league of legends. It happens to be one of the best animated sci-fi shows in history, an absolute masterpiece that requires no prior knowledge of the source material in order to be thoroughly enjoyed.

Diungkapkan bahwa full of richly layered and deeply moving character arcs, simple yet enrapturing world-building, gripping storylines and subplots, and compelling sociopolitical commentary, arcane is science fantasy at its very best. On top of being visually jaw-dropping and full of phenomenal music, it's one of the most engrossingly dramatic and incredibly action-packed adult animated shows that the small screen has seen in quite some time, and 18 episodes across two seasons were all it took for it to achieve that.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, yet another british cult classic that has kept aging like fine wine, patrick mcgoohan's the prisoner (starring mcgoohan himself) is one of those near-perfect sci-fi shows that nobody seems to remember. It follows an unnamed British secret agent who, after resigning from his job, is abducted and taken to a surreal coastal prison known as "The Village," where authorities try to get him to reveal why he quit.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one season, 17 episodes. The show grows more psychedelic, surreal, intellectually challenging, and downright Kafkaesque as it goes on, challenging the norms of episodic television from its time. That's all it took for The Prisoner to see an evolution more dramatic than what many other sci-fi shows see over the course of several seasons. As such, it feels surprisingly modern even today.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there is arguably no single-season sci-fi show more legendary or iconic than firefly, whose untimely cancellation remains one of the biggest tragedies in the modern history of network sci-fi television. Before the arrival of its upcoming animated continuation, now should be as perfect a time as any for those who haven't experienced this essential cult classic to finally give it a go.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's one of the most perfect sci-fi shows of the last 25 years, a space western with some of the most engaging characters and genre-cliché-defying stories that sci-fi has seen on television in a while. It delivers a timeless masterclass in ensemble writing, in delivering futuristic sci-fi grounded in realism, and in balancing episodic and serialized storytelling. It's a cult classic that anyone who loves the genre is pretty much guaranteed to thoroughly enjoy.

Between Fear the Walking Dead, Dead City, The Ones Who Live, and Daryl Dixon, there's plenty to keep fans looking forward to the next big release.

Berdasarkan laporan, still, nothing quite captures the magic of those early seasons of the walking dead, especially when it comes to the relationships between the original characters. Watching Rick struggle to keep his group alive while Daryl gradually evolved from a hotheaded loner into one of its most dependable members made for some of the show's best moments.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rick and daryl's friendship ultimately became one of the defining parts of the entire franchise, and fans have been eager to see the iconic duo together again. Fortunately, an official new Walking Dead release is bringing Rick and Daryl back together, offering a nostalgic return to the franchise's glory days.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rick grimes and daryl dixon are officially back together in the walking dead: streets of survival, which offers a nostalgic return to one of the franchise's most beloved eras. Released on September 18, 2026, the game comes from developer Odaclick Game Studio and publisher Trailmark Games, bringing several beloved characters back for an old-school zombie-slaying adventure.

Sebagaimana diketahui, streets of survival is a retro-inspired, side-scrolling beat-'em-up that draws heavily from the show's iconic "all out war" storyline, which saw rick and his allies facing off against negan and the saviors. The game features 12 levels, taking players through familiar locations like Alexandria, Hilltop, and the Sanctuary while battling hordes of walkers and hostile survivors.

Diungkapkan bahwa rick and daryl are both playable characters, each with their own abilities and signature weapons, including rick's magnum and daryl's crossbow. However, they're far from the only familiar faces making an appearance, with Michonne is another playable survivor, wielding her iconic katana, while Negan can be unlocked after completing the campaign, allowing players to unleash Lucille on their enemies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, other recognizable characters and enemies include simon, the terrifying winslow walker, and the infamous well walker from season 2. Beyond the combat, players can scavenge for supplies, collect upgrades, solve puzzles, and replay the campaign with different characters and difficulty settings.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unfortunately, streets of survival hasn't exactly received the warmest reception since launch. The game currently has a "Mostly Positive" overall rating on Steam, with approximately 70% positive reviews, although recent reviews have fallen into the "Mixed" category. Criticisms have focused on repetitive combat, the relatively short campaign, and the lack of co-op multiplayer.

Still, hardcore Walking Dead fans will likely find plenty to appreciate here, particularly those nostalgic for Rick and Daryl's earlier adventures together.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the walking dead: streets of survival is available now on pc via steam, ps5, xbox series x/s, nintendo switch, and nintendo switch 2. 99 Deluxe Edition includes additional cosmetics, an endless survival mode, and extra challenges. 99, while the $29. The standard edition costs $19. For fans looking to revisit the franchise's glory days, it's certainly worth considering.

#632. Nicholas Hoult Filmed 2 Different Endings for His ‘How to Rob a Bank’ Character

📅 14 Nov 2026

Nicholas Hoult Filmed 2 Different Endings for His ‘How to Rob a Bank’ Character

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://collider.com/how-to-rob-a-bank-endings-meaning-nicholas-hoult-anna-sawai-interview/

Berdasarkan laporan, in david leitch’s new heist thriller, how to rob a bank, a group of bank robbers take matters into their own hands when a flawed system fails them. Starring Nicholas Hoult, Pete Davidson, John C. Reilly, Zoë Kravitz, Anna Sawai, and Rhenzy Feliz, the movie takes audiences on a high-octane ride using 35mm film intertwined with attention-grabbing YouTube footage for a final cut even the cast didn’t see coming.

Sebagaimana diketahui, how to rob a bank follows an anonymous youtuber, “the wolf” (hoult), and a group of bank robbers — davidson, sawai, and feliz — who post their capers on the internet. As they continue to see success online, an FBI agent (Reilly) hires a hacker on house arrest (Kravitz) to help put an end to their escapades.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in this interview, collider’s steve weintraub talks with hoult, reilly, sawai, and feliz to discuss their approach to the material, working with leitch on different versions of their scenes, and how the film’s surprising perspectives came together in the end. Check out the full conversation in the video above, with a transcript provided below.

COLLIDER: John, I'm going to start with you.

Yeah, I was just curious how you feel when someone is wearing a bootleg T-shirt of your face during an interview for your new movie.

Diungkapkan bahwa reilly: i'm still getting used to it. Yeah. I'll let you know at the end of the interview.

Diungkapkan bahwa i wore this for something i did with will ferrell, and i handed him a dollar to give him a residual payment. I would do the same for you, but we are virtual.

Sebagaimana diketahui, reilly: you know, i would have done that movie for free. It was a joyful experience. But how about How to Rob a Bank?.

Berdasarkan laporan, i really want to start with congrats on the movie. I think the film does a great job of capturing the anger that so many of us feel about what's going on. But before I get into the film, I'm doing a supercut of everyone I'm interviewing right now, and I'm asking everyone where they like to sit in a movie theater.

Berdasarkan laporan, reilly: i like to sit on the aisle. First seat on the aisle, usually a little bit over to the right, about halfway down.

NICHOLAS HOULT: That’s pretty close to where I like to sit.

HOULT: I'm not necessarily right on the aisle, but close enough that if I have to get up, I don't have to go right past everyone.

Sebagaimana diketahui, feliz: i try to do everything possible to never have to get up through the movie, so i will do whatever i gotta do. Middle, but close-ish. I like to go middle. Not too close, but not middle-middle. Closer than middle, but not all the way forward.

Berdasarkan laporan, feliz: normally, it’s g. It’s right in the middle of G. At the Lincoln Center, it's G. So that’s, like, six, or something.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, anna sawai: [laughs] i'm in the middle but towards the back. But I like to be in the center.

HOULT: Does anybody ever say, like, front left?.

Berdasarkan laporan, i've had people say they actually like being the first or second row. I think they're insane, but by all means. That's the great thing about this question is you get all sorts of answers.

REILLY: Well, there's always a seat available if it gets crowded, because most people don't pick that front row.

Sebagaimana diketahui, from 'talladega nights' to 'step brothers,' these are some of john c. Reilly's funniest performances to date.

Jumping into why I get to talk to you guys, like I said, I really do think that this captures a lot of the anger that so many of us feel, and I'm just curious, how did the finished film actually compare to the script you read and what David [Leitch] told you about it going in?.

Berdasarkan laporan, sawai: i feel like when i read it, i was reading with emmy in mind, and so everything kind of felt really heavy. But I was surprised at how entertaining and fun it was, because I forgot that it was more of that in the film.

Berdasarkan laporan, feliz: i guess maybe, yeah, a similar thing where the perspective was from the robbers’ side, and then when i watched the final version of it, it felt like so much more of the perspective was sort of looking at us instead of it coming from us. I felt the audience would maybe know more about us, and when I watched, I was like, “Oh, we're a little bit out of reach, just slightly. And I think I also felt more mysterious in the edit when I watched the movie than I felt when I was making it. ” Like, it's the chase, which I think actually, it's better than what I had thought up in my head when I was reading the script.

Berdasarkan laporan, hoult: seeing the film was exciting because, like rhenzy was saying, all of john and zoë [kravitz]’s part of the movie we weren't present for. So, to see how they developed those characters and that side of the story was really exciting and fun to watch.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, then these robberies, because they're so different, the film parts of this are so grounded and lived in and very beautifully shot, and then this content that they create is so fast. The way that that was shot with these POV cameras and lenses attached to us and the stunt team itself, it was so frantic. So to see how those things combined, I just think David did a really creative, wonderful job mixing those mediums in many ways.

Diungkapkan bahwa but also, he's so open to ideas and trying things that even whether my character died or didn't die wasn't decided fully. So we shot both versions of that towards the end of the movie, and it was only when he was done editing and stuff that he made the final decision on those things. So, it's kind of a nice surprise seeing the movie for me because there were lots of undecided things. [Laughs].

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, reilly: i think playing a character in a movie is similar to life, in that everyone walks through life like they're the lead character. And then you see all this is social media content that's part of the movie and what's actually happening in the heist and everything. And so I thought the movie was about a guy trying to catch some bank robbers. You know, your experiences, the way you're seeing your life. So yeah, like Nick was just saying, it’s always a delight to see the parts of the movie that you were not present for when it was being filmed.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nick, i really think that the youtube stuff that's in this is just so well done. I’m curious if, as you were filming it, did you gain a newfound respect for content creators being able to talk to the camera and pull you in?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this team is obviously really great at it and has tapped into a nerve. And like you were saying, people are angry about many different things, so there's this element of creating a voice for people that feel like they aren't being heard is a special thing. But yeah, it gave me a whole new level of respect because it's not something I could do — particularly while I was robbing banks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, 100%. One of the things I love learning about is the behind-the-scenes, the making of a movie, and I love learning shit that you cannot find on Wikipedia or in the press notes. For soon-to-be fans of the film, is there anything that you think would be cool to learn or exciting or unique about actually making this film?.

Berdasarkan laporan, reilly: the guns had blanks in them. They weren't actual, real bullets.

Berdasarkan laporan, hoult: every sixth one was a real bullet, and they wouldn't tell us. [Laughs].

Diungkapkan bahwa one of the things i'm so curious about is when you guys are making a movie like this, the four of you are never working together. This is like your first day, when you're doing press, that you're with each other. What have you learned about each other through a day of doing press?.

Berdasarkan laporan, reilly: i've learned if there's a pause, i'll start talking. I’ve learned that about myself.

Berdasarkan laporan, hoult: i've learned to pause so that john will start talking. We went to go to dinner together. No, actually, when we all got to Pittsburgh, us four were the first four people to hang out. So, this is like the reunion of the OG core group.

REILLY: Yeah, and my first day was the interrogations, so I actually spent the day with everybody the very first day of shooting.

Sebagaimana diketahui, feliz: we’re all great friends. We've done it all. We've done roller coaster rides. We've done pickle rides. We're a tight-knit unit.

That’s only if you still have a text chain going.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, feliz: well, actually, for a while there, we did, and it was one of the highlights of my day, actually. We gotta fire that back up again.

I love learning about how actors get ready for a role or a big scene, so when you're making a film like this or filming in general, and you have a big scene coming up on a Monday, how are you getting ready for that? Is it in the days leading up to it, or are you always thinking about it weeks in advance? I'm just fascinated by how actors get ready for a role or a big scene, because it's something that I could never do myself.

Sebagaimana diketahui, reilly: well, there’s the learning of dialogue, of course, memorizing your lines and all that stuff, but i find myself really making sure that i understand the emotional shifts in the scene — when things change, when does the temperature in the room change when someone says this or that — and then you kind of compare notes with the director when you get there. You know, you give your take on it.

I think every actor has their own process, actually, very individually, but my thing is I always try to leave enough space so that in case my interpretation is not what the director wants, that I can pivot, that I'm not set in something so much that I can't do what they want me to do.

Diungkapkan bahwa hoult: i try not to think of it as a big scene if it's a big scene. Does that make sense? Because if you're like, “Oh, this is a big scene,” then you're probably going to intimidate yourself into not being loose and free with it. So I try and prepare as much as possible, but then also remember that it's a culmination of all the scenes and all the work that make the difference, not necessarily this one pivotal thing, so you can go in there and approach it with a sense of ease and have fun with it, I guess.

Sebagaimana diketahui, feliz: that's something i still got to learn. I feel like I try not to think of it as such a big thing, but I find myself….

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, hoult: well, i still do it. I’m still like, “It's a big one!”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, feliz: yeah, i know the day it’s coming up. You guys actually both said it. But I think what you said was crucial. You prepare, and you try to figure out exactly what the heck's going on with your character in the moment, and all the lines, and you know everything, hopefully, so well that you can sort of feel the freedom to go in and try to find something natural and fun and spontaneous amidst all the preparation.

Diungkapkan bahwa i think the only times i've ever felt comfortable going into big days is when i feel like i know so much about what's going on in the moment with the character, with the scene and the movie in that moment that i'm open to so many different kinds of things happening on the day. But I've been guilty of maybe not being prepared as much as I should have on some days, and that's when I go into it the most nervous and the most in my head about things.

Berdasarkan laporan, sawai: also, sometimes they can change the script the day before. So, you do as much preparation as you can, like they said, but yeah, you just have to go in and do what you can.

How to Rob a Bank opens in theaters on November 13.

#635. How to get Go Safari Balls in Pokémon Go

📅 23 Nov 2024

How to get Go Safari Balls in Pokémon Go

Tanggal: 23 Nov 2024 | Sumber: https://www.polygon.com/pokemon-go-guide/483165/go-safari-balls-how-to-get/

These high catch rate balls will help you grab rare Pokémon quickly.

These high catch rate balls will help you grab rare Pokémon quickly.

Berdasarkan laporan, you can get go safari balls as part of pokémon go wild area events, and can only be used during event hours. No, seriously — they disappear after the event ends.

Sebagaimana diketahui, these balls are based off of the regular camouflaged-print safari balls from the mainline games. Usually, you can only use Safari Balls in the Safari Zone, a special area where wild Pokémon roam and you can’t actually battle them. You can throw treats and rocks at them to try to increase their catch rate, but ultimately, you just had to huck Safari Balls at them to catch some of these rare critters.

Pokémon Go has its own take on Safari Balls, and we explain what Go Safari Balls do, and how to get more.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, go safari balls are special poké balls that have a higher catch rate. While the catch rate isn’t 100% known, it is known to be much better than an Ultra Ball.

Berdasarkan laporan, they are particularly effective against "mighty pokémon", which also debut as part of the go wild area event, but know you can use them for anything. This includes Galarian birds, which have a notoriously low catch rate, so make sure to use your Daily Adventure Incense during the event period to increase your chances if you haven’t got them yet.

For those with a paid Go Wild Area ticket, during the raid’s catch phase, Premier Balls will also be swapped out for Go Safari Balls in raids and Max Battles — but know any leftovers will be discarded and not kept for other encounters.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, remember, these are an event exclusive ball and will disappear at the end of the event on sunday, nov. m. 15 — so be sure to use them before 6 p. in your local time on Sunday rolls round.

Pokémon caught in Go Safari Balls can be transferred to Pokémon Home, but the appearance of the ball is changed into a greenish "Strange Ball" once transferred.

Diungkapkan bahwa there are a few ways to get more go safari balls during the event, though not very many options for players looking to avoid spending. That being said, you’ll want to start playing early to complete the research if you want to get and use your allotment of Go Safari Balls before they vanish.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, note that even the paid balls will disappear on sunday, nov. m. 15 at 6 p. in your local time, so make sure you use them up.
